kits.name: STEMdiff Trilineage Differentiation Kit (three parallel monolayer arms)
kits.principle: A functional pluripotency assay: single-cell hPSCs are plated in three sets of wells and each set is fed daily with one complete, ready-to-use medium that drives it to ectoderm, mesoderm or endoderm. It is an endpoint assay read by lineage markers within a week, not a way to make cells for further differentiation.
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF, used when they are ready for passaging (mostly large, compact colonies with multilayered centres); scrape off differentiated areas first. Dissociate to single cells with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent and plate on Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix (24-well format in the PIS) in maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632. Densities: ectoderm 200,000 cells/cm2, mesoderm 50,000 cells/cm2, endoderm 200,000 cells/cm2.

stages.name: Day 0: plate single cells for all three arms
stages.base_medium: Single-Cell Plating Medium (mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF + 10 µM Y-27632)

factors.name: Y-27632 (Dihydrochloride) (not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor in the single-cell plating medium, day 0 only

stages.feeding: No feeding; leave undisturbed for 24 h
actions: Coat 24-well plates with Matrigel and bring to room temperature for at least 30 min
Remove differentiated regions, rinse with D-PBS, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 8-10 min at 37°C and pipette to single cells
Collect in DMEM/F-12, spin 300 x g for 5 min, resuspend in plating medium and count with Trypan Blue
Put 0.5 mL plating medium per 24-well, then add cells: 400,000 per well for ectoderm and endoderm, 100,000 per well for mesoderm (12-well: 800,000 / 200,000; 6-well: 2,000,000 / 500,000)
Shake the plate back-and-forth and side-to-side in the incubator to spread the cells

stages.name: Ectoderm arm (seeded at 200,000 cells/cm2; harvest day 7)
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Trilineage Ectoderm Medium (ready to use)

factors.name: STEMdiff Trilineage Ectoderm Medium
factors.role: days 1-7 medium for the ectoderm wells (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Full medium change every 24 h from day 1; 1 mL per 24-well (1.5 mL per 12-well, 3 mL per 6-well)
actions: Day 1: aspirate plating medium and add room-temperature Ectoderm Medium
Repeat the full change daily
Day 7: harvest and/or fix for marker analysis
stages.checkpoint: Day 7: PAX6 together with Nestin by flow cytometry or immunocytochemistry (or transcriptome analysis)

stages.name: Mesoderm arm (seeded at 50,000 cells/cm2; harvest day 5)
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Trilineage Mesoderm Medium (ready to use)

factors.name: STEMdiff Trilineage Mesoderm Medium
factors.role: days 1-5 medium for the mesoderm wells (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Full medium change every 24 h from day 1; 1 mL per 24-well
actions: Day 1: aspirate plating medium and add room-temperature Mesoderm Medium
Repeat the full change daily
Day 5: harvest and/or fix for marker analysis
stages.checkpoint: Day 5: Brachyury (T) together with NCAM (CD56) or CXCR4 (CD184)

stages.name: Endoderm arm (seeded at 200,000 cells/cm2; harvest day 5)
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Trilineage Endoderm Medium (ready to use)

factors.name: STEMdiff Trilineage Endoderm Medium
factors.role: days 1-5 medium for the endoderm wells (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Full medium change every 24 h from day 1; 1 mL per 24-well
actions: Day 1: aspirate plating medium and add room-temperature Endoderm Medium
Repeat the full change daily
Day 5: harvest and/or fix for marker analysis
stages.checkpoint: Day 5: SOX17 together with CXCR4 or FOXA2

materials: STEMdiff Trilineage Differentiation Kit (05230): Ectoderm Medium 175 mL, Mesoderm Medium 100 mL, Endoderm Medium 100 mL
Example antibodies: Anti-Human Nestin clone 10C2 (60091), Anti-Human CD56 clone HCD56 (60021), Anti-Human CD184 clone 12G5 (60089)
tips: Thawed Ectoderm and Mesoderm Medium keep 2 weeks at 2-8°C; Endoderm Medium only 1 week. Aliquots can be frozen once at -20°C; do not refreeze.
Do not filter the media.
The kit is validated for lines kept in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF.
pitfalls: The mesoderm arm is seeded four-fold lower than the other two; using one density for all wells will distort the result.
This is an endpoint assay; the PIS says it is not optimized for producing cells for downstream differentiation.
Moving the plate in the first 24 h after plating gives uneven monolayers.
unverified: Efficiency: the PIS gives no percentage for any germ layer.
The PIS says to repeat the daily change 'until day 5' (mesoderm, endoderm) or 'day 7' (ectoderm) and to harvest on those same days; whether a final feed is given on the harvest day is not explicit.
The protocol diagram is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Definitive Endoderm Kit (Supplement MR + CJ, 5 days)
kits.principle: A near-confluent single-cell hPSC monolayer gets one day of basal medium with both Supplement MR and Supplement CJ, then three days with Supplement CJ alone, giving CXCR4+/SOX17+/FOXA2+/c-KIT+ definitive endoderm on day 5. The TeSR-E8 Optimized kit (05115) adds a 20X supplement used to pre-condition TeSR-E8 cultures before plating.
kits.product: STEMdiff Definitive Endoderm Kit; STEMdiff Definitive Endoderm Kit (TeSR-E8 Optimized)
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs about 70% confluent, maintained in eTeSR, mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF (kit 05110) or in TeSR-E8 (kit 05115, after at least 24 h in TeSR-E8 Pre-Differentiation Medium). Single-cell passage with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent onto CellAdhere Laminin-521, Corning Matrigel hESC-qualified matrix or Vitronectin XF (Matrigel or Vitronectin XF only for TeSR-E8 cultures) at 2.1 x 10^5 cells/cm2 (2 x 10^6 cells per well of a 6-well plate) in maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632. Cells must be about 90-100% confluent on day 1.

stages.name: TeSR-E8 pre-conditioning (kit 05115 only)
stages.base_medium: TeSR-E8 Pre-Differentiation Medium (19 mL complete TeSR-E8 + 1 mL STEMdiff Definitive Endoderm TeSR-E8 Supplement)

factors.name: STEMdiff Definitive Endoderm TeSR-E8 Supplement (20X)
factors.role: added to complete TeSR-E8 before plating (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Daily full change, 2 mL per 6-well, for at least 24 h and until about 70% confluent
actions: Passage TeSR-E8 cultures as usual onto Matrigel or Vitronectin XF and feed daily with TeSR-E8 for 4-5 days
Switch to Pre-Differentiation Medium and keep feeding daily until about 70% confluent
Skip this stage entirely for eTeSR, mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF cultures (kit 05110)
stages.checkpoint: About 70% confluent, with at least 24 h of exposure to Pre-Differentiation Medium

stages.name: Day 0: single-cell plating
stages.base_medium: Single-Cell Passaging Medium (maintenance medium, or TeSR-E8 Pre-Differentiation Medium for 05115, + 10 µM Y-27632)

factors.name: Y-27632 (Dihydrochloride) (not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor in the single-cell plating medium, day 0 only

stages.feeding: No feeding for 24 h
actions: Coat a 6-well plate (tissue culture-treated for Laminin-521 or Matrigel; non-treated for Vitronectin XF) and warm to room temperature
Rinse with D-PBS, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 8-10 min at 37°C, pipette to single cells
Dilute in DMEM/F-12 with 15 mM HEPES, spin 300 x g for 5 min, resuspend and count live cells
Plate 2.1 x 10^5 cells/cm2 (2 x 10^6 per 6-well); adjust for your line
stages.checkpoint: About 90-100% confluent on day 1

stages.name: Day 1: Definitive Endoderm Medium 1
stages.base_medium: Definitive Endoderm Medium 1 (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium + Supplement MR + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Single 2 mL per 6-well dose for 24 h
actions: Make Medium 1 fresh; it cannot be stored
Wash wells once with 1 mL DMEM/F-12 with 15 mM HEPES
Add 2 mL Medium 1 per well

stages.name: Days 2-4: Definitive Endoderm Medium 2
stages.base_medium: Definitive Endoderm Medium 2 (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Daily full change on days 2, 3 and 4, 2 mL per 6-well
actions: Prepare 6 mL per well on day 2 and keep it at 2-8°C between feeds
Warm only the 2 mL needed and change without a wash
Day 5: assay or carry into a lineage protocol
stages.checkpoint: Day 5: purity by flow cytometry for CXCR4 (CD184) with c-Kit (CD117) or SOX17; marker expression may already peak on day 4 in some lines

materials: STEMdiff Definitive Endoderm Kit (05110): Endoderm Basal Medium 100 mL, Supplement MR (100X) 0.35 mL, Supplement CJ (100X) 1.1 mL
STEMdiff Definitive Endoderm Kit (TeSR-E8 Optimized) (05115): the same plus Definitive Endoderm TeSR-E8 Supplement (20X) 7 mL
CellAdhere Laminin-521 (200-0117), Corning Matrigel hESC-qualified matrix (Corning 354277) or Vitronectin XF (07180; needs CellAdhere Dilution Buffer 07183)
Example antibodies: Anti-Human CD184 clone 12G5 (60089), Anti-Human CD117 clone 104D2 (60087)
tips: Choose the kit by maintenance medium: 05110 for eTeSR, mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus and TeSR-AOF; 05115 for TeSR-E8.
Thawed basal medium keeps 2 months at 2-8°C (frozen aliquots 2 weeks after thawing); thawed supplement aliquots must be used at once.
Tune the seeding number so the well is 90-100% confluent on day 1.
TeSR-E8 Pre-Differentiation Medium keeps 2 weeks at 2-8°C.
pitfalls: Medium 1 must be made fresh on day 1 and not stored.
TeSR-E8 cultures need at least 24 h in Pre-Differentiation Medium before day 0.
Purity varies with the cell line; check day 4 as well as day 5 for a new line.
unverified: Efficiency: no percentage is given in the PIS.
The TeSR-E8 pre-conditioning stage is drawn as day -1 to 0; the PIS only says 'at least 24 hours' and until about 70% confluent, so it can be longer.
The protocol diagram is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Mesoderm Induction Medium (one complete medium, days 1-5)
kits.principle: A sparse single-cell hPSC monolayer is fed daily with one complete, defined, xeno-free medium that needs no added factors, giving early Brachyury+ OCT4- mesoderm that can be assayed or pushed on to more specialized mesodermal lineages.
kits.efficiency: typically 80 - 99% Brachyury+OCT4- cells
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs in mTeSR1, TeSR-E8, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF, ready for passage (large compact colonies with dense centres). Single-cell passage with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent onto Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix or Vitronectin XF at 5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 (5 x 10^5 per 6-well, 2 x 10^5 per 12-well, 1 x 10^5 per 24-well) in maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632; 20-50% confluent on day 1.

stages.name: Day 0: single-cell plating
stages.base_medium: Single-Cell Plating Medium (maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632)

factors.name: Y-27632 (Dihydrochloride) (not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor in the single-cell plating medium, day 0 only

stages.feeding: No feeding for 24 h
actions: Bring coated plates to room temperature for at least 30 min
Rinse with D-PBS, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 8-10 min at 37°C and pipette to single cells
Spin 300 x g for 5 min, resuspend in plating medium and count with Trypan Blue
Plate 5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 in 2 mL per 6-well
If the cells are going into the STEMdiff Endothelial Differentiation Kit (08005), seed 0.5-1 x 10^4 cells/cm2 in mTeSR1 + 10 µM Y-27632 on a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate instead
stages.checkpoint: 20-50% confluent on day 1

stages.name: Days 1-5: mesoderm induction
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Mesoderm Induction Medium (complete as supplied)
stages.feeding: Full change every 24 h on days 1, 2, 3 and 4; 3 mL per 6-well, 1.5 mL per 12-well, 1 mL per 24-well
actions: Warm the medium to room temperature
Replace the medium daily
Day 5: assay, or transfer into a downstream protocol (any time between day 3 and day 5, depending on the target cell type)
stages.checkpoint: Day 5: Brachyury or NCAM (CD56) positive and OCT4 negative by flow cytometry

materials: STEMdiff Mesoderm Induction Medium (05220, 100 mL; 05221, 500 mL)
Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix (Corning 354277) or Vitronectin XF (07180)
mTeSR1 (85850), TeSR-E8 (05990), mTeSR Plus (100-0276) or TeSR-AOF (100-0401)
Example antibodies: Anti-Human CD56 clone HCD56 (60021), Anti-Human OCT4 clone 3A2A20 (60093)
tips: Thawed medium keeps 1 month at 2-8°C; frozen aliquots keep 2 weeks after thawing. Do not filter it.
The seeding density may need adjusting for the cell line and maintenance medium.
The best day to move cells into a downstream protocol varies between day 3 and day 5.
pitfalls: Starting too dense or too sparse: the monolayer should be 20-50% confluent on day 1.
The medium contains human plasma-derived material; handle with universal precautions.
unverified: For density by cell line and maintenance medium the PIS points to Table 2 of another document (#10000006932), which is not in the text supplied.
This PIS has no protocol diagram in the extracted text.

kits.name: STEMdiff Hepatocyte Kit (three stages, 21 days)
kits.principle: A serum-free, three-stage 2D protocol on Laminin-521: definitive endoderm with the Supplement MR/CJ system (days 1-5), hepatic progenitors in Hepatic Progenitor Medium (days 5-10), then hepatocyte-like cells in Hepatocyte Medium (days 10-21) that express albumin and alpha-1 antitrypsin.
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained in eTeSR, mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF on CellAdhere Laminin-521 (cells kept on Matrigel should be adapted to Laminin-521 for at least one passage); seed 6-8 days after their last passage, after removing differentiated areas. Plate single cells in maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632 on Laminin-521-coated (8 µg/mL, overnight at 2-8°C) 24- or 96-well tissue culture-treated plates. Seeding by maintenance medium: eTeSR 4.21 x 10^4, mTeSR1 2.11 x 10^5, mTeSR Plus 1.05 x 10^5, TeSR-AOF 2.11 x 10^5 cells/cm2. Monolayer must be at least 80% (80-100%) confluent on day 1.

stages.name: Day 0: seed hPSCs on Laminin-521
stages.base_medium: Single-cell passaging medium (maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632)

factors.name: Y-27632 (Dihydrochloride) (not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor in the single-cell plating medium, day 0 only

stages.feeding: No feeding for 24 h
actions: The day before: dilute CellAdhere Laminin-521 to 8 µg/mL in ice-cold D-PBS with Ca/Mg, add 0.25 mL per 24-well (50 µL per 96-well), seal and coat overnight at 2-8°C
Swap the coating solution directly for passaging medium (0.5 mL per 24-well, 0.1 mL per 96-well) without letting the surface dry
Scrape off differentiated areas, rinse with D-PBS, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 8-10 min at 37°C and pipette to single cells
Count, spin 300 x g for 5 min and seed at the density for your maintenance medium
96-well plates: seed with a multichannel pipette and leave 1 h in the cabinet to settle
Seed spare wells if you want to check endoderm on day 5 and hepatic progenitors on day 10
stages.checkpoint: At least 80% confluent after 24 h; if not, change to fresh maintenance medium and wait a further 24 h

stages.name: Day 1: Medium 1 (endoderm induction)
stages.base_medium: Medium 1 (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium (Hepatic) + Supplement MR + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Single full change, 0.5 mL per 24-well (0.1 mL per 96-well), for 24 h
actions: Prepare Medium 1 and Medium 2 on day 1
Start only when wells are 80-100% confluent
Change to Medium 1

stages.name: Days 2-4: Medium 2 (definitive endoderm)
stages.base_medium: Medium 2 (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium (Hepatic) + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Full change on days 2, 3 and 4, 0.5 mL per 24-well
actions: Change to Medium 2 daily
Day 4: start thawing Hepatic Progenitor Medium overnight at 2-8°C
stages.checkpoint: Day 5: definitive endoderm by flow cytometry (CXCR4, c-Kit or SOX17) or qPCR (FOXA2, SOX17, CXCR4)

stages.name: Days 5-10: hepatic progenitors
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Hepatic Progenitor Medium (ready to use)
stages.feeding: Full change of 0.5 mL per 24-well on days 5, 6, 7 and 9, as listed in the PIS
actions: Change to Hepatic Progenitor Medium on day 5 and feed on the listed days
Day 9: start thawing Hepatocyte Medium overnight at 2-8°C
Antibiotics (1%) may be added if wanted
stages.checkpoint: Day 10: hepatic progenitors by morphology, qPCR (AFP, HNF1B, CK19, HNF6, TBX3) or flow cytometry (% AFP+, HNF1B+, CK19+)

stages.name: Days 10-21: hepatocyte-like cells
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Hepatocyte Medium (ready to use)
stages.feeding: Full change of 0.5 mL per 24-well on day 10, day 12 and then every 2 days
actions: Change to Hepatocyte Medium on day 10
Feed every 2 days
Day 21: analyse
stages.checkpoint: Day 21: functional assays (CYP3A4 activity, albumin ELISA), qPCR (ALB, A1AT, HNF4A, CYP3A4, ASGR1, CPS1) and flow cytometry (% ALB+ and % A1AT+)

materials: STEMdiff Hepatocyte Kit (100-0520): Endoderm Basal Medium (Hepatic) 100 mL, Definitive Endoderm 100X Supplement MR 0.35 mL, Supplement CJ 1.1 mL, Hepatic Progenitor Medium 100 mL, Hepatocyte Medium 150 mL
D-PBS with calcium and magnesium (Thermo Fisher 14040133)
eTeSR (100-1215), mTeSR1 (85850), mTeSR Plus (100-0276) or TeSR-AOF (100-0401)
tips: Run a seeding-density titration for first experiments and for each new line; the recommended density differs five-fold between eTeSR and mTeSR1 cultures.
Medium 1 keeps 1 day and Medium 2 keeps 3 days at 2-8°C; thawed Hepatic Progenitor Medium keeps 3 weeks and Hepatocyte Medium 2 weeks.
Laminin-521-coated plates can be stored up to 4 weeks at 2-8°C if sealed and never allowed to dry.
Warm media to room temperature before use.
pitfalls: Starting below 80% confluence on day 1.
Leaving differentiated colonies in the starting culture lowers efficiency.
Letting the Laminin-521 coat dry out inactivates it.
unverified: Efficiency: the PIS gives no percentage of ALB+ or A1AT+ cells.
Day 8: the PIS lists feeds on days 5, 6, 7 and 9 of the hepatic progenitor stage and does not mention day 8; whether day 8 is deliberately skipped is not stated.
The protocol diagram is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Pancreatic Progenitor Kit (four stages, six media)
kits.principle: A serum-free four-stage monolayer protocol with daily feeding: definitive endoderm (2 days), primitive gut tube (3 days), posterior foregut endoderm (3 days) and pancreatic progenitors, giving PDX1+ NKX6.1+ SOX9+ cells that can be transplanted or matured further towards insulin-producing cells with published protocols.
kits.efficiency: typically in the range of 66.5 - 74.5% PDX1+NKX6.1+ cells
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1 (or mTeSR Plus), about 70% confluent. Single-cell passage with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent onto tissue culture-treated 6-well plates coated with Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix for at least 2 h at 37°C, at 2.6 x 10^5 cells/cm2 (2.5 x 10^6 cells per well) in mTeSR1 + 10 µM Y-27632. Must be about 90-100% confluent on day 1. For mTeSR Plus cultures, halve the seeding density and seed in mTeSR1 on day 0 (24 h transition).

stages.name: Day 0: single-cell plating
stages.base_medium: Single-Cell Passaging Medium (mTeSR1 + 10 µM Y-27632)

factors.name: Y-27632 (Dihydrochloride) (not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor in the single-cell plating medium, day 0 only

stages.feeding: No feeding for 24 h
actions: Coat plates with Matrigel at 37°C for at least 2 h to limit monolayer detachment later
Rinse with D-PBS, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 6-10 min at 37°C, pipette 1-3 times to single cells
Dilute in DMEM/F-12, spin 300 x g for 5 min, resuspend and count; do not over-triturate or leave cells sitting in DMEM/F-12
Plate 2.6 x 10^5 viable cells/cm2 straight after aspirating the Matrigel
stages.checkpoint: About 90-100% confluent on day 1; if not, restart with a corrected cell number rather than waiting

stages.name: Stage 1 day 1: Medium 1A
stages.base_medium: Medium 1A (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium + Supplement MR + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Single 2 mL per 6-well dose for 24 h, warmed to 37°C
actions: Prepare Medium 1A (use at once) and Medium 1B (store at 2-8°C)
Replace mTeSR1 with warm Medium 1A
stages.checkpoint: Some cell death in Stage 1 is expected and is allowed for in the seeding density

stages.name: Stage 1 day 2: Medium 1B (definitive endoderm)
stages.base_medium: Medium 1B (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Single 2 mL dose for 24 h
actions: Warm Medium 1B to 37°C and change the medium
stages.checkpoint: Definitive endoderm can be checked by flow cytometry for CXCR4 with c-Kit or SOX17

stages.name: Stage 2 day 1: Medium 2A
stages.base_medium: Medium 2A (STEMdiff Pancreatic Stage 2 - 4 Basal Medium + Supplement 2A + Supplement 2B)
stages.feeding: Single 2 mL dose for 24 h
actions: Prepare Medium 2A (use at once) and Medium 2B (store at 2-8°C)
Change to warm Medium 2A

stages.name: Stage 2 days 2-3: Medium 2B (primitive gut tube)
stages.base_medium: Medium 2B (STEMdiff Pancreatic Stage 2 - 4 Basal Medium + Supplement 2B)
stages.feeding: Daily full change, 2 mL per 6-well
actions: Warm only the 2 mL needed each day
Change the medium gently down the wall of the well

stages.name: Stage 3: Medium 3 (posterior foregut endoderm)
stages.base_medium: Medium 3 (STEMdiff Pancreatic Stage 2 - 4 Basal Medium + Supplement 3)
stages.feeding: Daily full change for 3 days, 2 mL per 6-well
actions: Prepare 6 mL per well on Stage 3 day 1 and keep at 2-8°C
Warm 2 mL per well per day and change daily

stages.name: Stage 4: Medium 4 (pancreatic progenitors)
stages.base_medium: Medium 4 (STEMdiff Pancreatic Stage 2 - 4 Basal Medium + Supplement 4)
stages.feeding: Daily full change on Stage 4 days 1-5, 2 mL per 6-well
actions: Stage 4 day 1: prepare Medium 4 for days 1-3 and freeze a Supplement 4 aliquot for day 4
Stage 4 day 4: prepare fresh Medium 4 for days 4 and 5 from the frozen aliquot
Stage 4 day 6: assay or use the cells (for example transplantation or endocrine maturation)
stages.checkpoint: PDX1 and NKX6.1 co-expression (also SOX9); the PIS refers to Zhao et al. 2023 (J Vis Exp, doi 10.3791/64840) for evaluation and onward differentiation to islet clusters

materials: STEMdiff Pancreatic Progenitor Kit (05120): Endoderm Basal Medium 100 mL, Pancreatic Stage 2 - 4 Basal Medium 265 mL, Definitive Endoderm Supplement MR (100X) 350 µL and CJ (100X) 1.1 mL, Pancreatic Supplement 2A 240 µL, 2B 720 µL, 3 720 µL, 4 1200 µL
tips: Seeding density is the main variable; the best number depends on how fast the line grows.
Add and remove medium slowly at the well wall; a little medium left behind does no harm.
Stage 2-4 Basal Medium is stored at 2-8°C; supplements are thawed on ice, and leftover supplement can be frozen once in aliquots.
Lines kept in mTeSR Plus: halve the seeding density and plate in mTeSR1 on day 0.
pitfalls: If the well is not 90-100% confluent on day 1, do not extend the culture; restart.
Monolayer detachment: coat with Matrigel for at least 2 h at 37°C and avoid scratching or aspirating the sheet.
Supplements 2B, 3 and 4 contain human plasma-derived material.
unverified: Stage 4 length: the heading says '6 days', but feeds are given on Stage 4 days 1-5 and cells are ready 'on Day 6 of Stage 4'. Continuous day numbers here assume day 0 = seeding and Stage 1 day 1 = day 1, which puts the endpoint on day 14; the PIS itself numbers days within each stage only.
Supplement concentrations (X) for the Pancreatic Supplements are not printed; only volumes are given.
The schematic is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Intestinal Organoid Kit (endoderm, mid-/hindgut spheroids, Matrigel domes)
kits.principle: Based on Spence et al. 2011: a clump-seeded hPSC monolayer is taken to definitive endoderm (3 days), then to mid-/hindgut, where spheroids bud off into the medium; these are collected, embedded in Matrigel domes and grown in Intestinal Organoid Growth Medium into organoids with epithelium and mesenchyme that can be passaged every 7-10 days or frozen.
kits.product: STEMdiff Intestinal Organoid Kit; STEMdiff Intestinal Organoid Growth Medium
kits.start_requirements: High-quality hPSCs (under 5% differentiation) in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF, about 70% confluent. Clump-passage with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (8 min at room temperature, then scrape) and seed 6,000 clumps of 50-200 µm per well of a 24-well plate coated with Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix, in 0.5 mL maintenance medium; no ROCK inhibitor is used. Start when 85-90% confluent, 24 h later.

stages.name: Day -1: clump seeding
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF
stages.feeding: No feeding for 24 h; if under 85-90% confluent, give fresh medium and wait another 24 h
actions: Coat a 24-well tissue culture-treated plate with Matrigel for at least 1 h at room temperature
Remove differentiated areas, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 8 min at room temperature, scrape in maintenance medium
Pipette to 50-200 µm clumps (not single cells) and count clumps in a 5 µL sample
Seed 6,000 clumps per well; for a new line compare 4,000, 5,000 and 6,000
Rock the plate to spread the clumps and leave it undisturbed
stages.checkpoint: 85-90% confluent with under 5% differentiation before day 0

stages.name: Days 0-3: definitive endoderm
stages.base_medium: DE Medium (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium + STEMdiff Definitive Endoderm Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Full change every 24 h or less: 0.7 mL per 24-well on day 0, 0.5 mL on days 1 and 2, warmed to 37°C
actions: Make DE Medium for all three days on day 0 and keep it at 2-8°C
Add medium dropwise down the side of a tilted plate
Keep the plate out of the incubator as briefly as possible; the cells are fragile after the first 24 h
stages.checkpoint: Heavy cell death is normal; by 72 h a confluent sheet of tightly packed endoderm. Day 3: FOXA2, SOX17, CXCR4 and c-KIT by flow cytometry or FOXA2/SOX17 staining

stages.name: Days 3-8: mid-/hindgut and spheroid release
stages.base_medium: MH Medium (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium + STEMdiff Gastrointestinal Supplement PK + Supplement UB)
stages.feeding: Full change of 0.5 mL every 24 h (days 3 to 9 at the latest), medium at room temperature
actions: Day 3: switch to MH Medium
From day 4, move each day's spent medium to a spare 24-well plate to count the spheroids that have lifted, then add fresh MH Medium
Return plates to the incubator within 30 min
On the chosen day (spheroids float free on days 5-9; day 8 often shows most budding) collect about 50 free-floating spheroids per dome into a 15 mL tube
Harvest on the same day in every experiment: time in MH Medium sets regional identity (shorter towards duodenum, longer towards ileum)
stages.checkpoint: 3D structures may appear from day 4; free-floating spheroids of 75 µm or more on days 5-9. Mid-/hindgut cells are CDX2+

stages.name: Embed spheroids and grow organoids
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Intestinal Organoid Growth Medium (Intestinal Organoid Basal Medium + Intestinal Organoid Supplement + L-Glutamine)
stages.feeding: 0.5 mL per well; full change every 3-4 days
actions: Let spheroids settle, wash with 1 mL DMEM/F-12 with 15 mM HEPES, spin 300 x g for 5 min and remove as much liquid as possible
With a cold 100 µL tip mix the pellet into 50 µL cold Matrigel GFR (Corning 356231) and place one dome in the centre of a 24-well
Let the dome set 20 min at room temperature, then add 0.5 mL room-temperature growth medium at the side of the well

After 7-10 days passage: break the dome in cold DMEM/F-12, pipette organoids to 100-500 µm fragments in tubes pre-rinsed with Anti-Adherence Rinsing Solution, let fragments settle on ice, wash, spin 200 x g for 5 min and re-embed in 50 µL Matrigel
Keep passaging every 7-10 days, or freeze fragments in CryoStor CS10
stages.checkpoint: Organoids with epithelium and mesenchyme; 40-80 organoids per dome is the target density. Markers listed: CDX2, E-cadherin, EpCAM, MUC2, KRT20, villin, KLF5, SOX9, CHGA, vimentin, desmin

materials: STEMdiff Intestinal Organoid Kit (05140): Endoderm Basal Medium 100 mL, Definitive Endoderm Supplement CJ (100X) 1.1 mL, Gastrointestinal Supplement PK 0.64 mL, Gastrointestinal Supplement UB 0.64 mL, Intestinal Organoid Basal Medium 100 mL, Intestinal Organoid Supplement 2 mL
STEMdiff Intestinal Organoid Growth Medium (05145) for continued passaging: Intestinal Organoid Basal Medium + Intestinal Organoid Supplement
Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix (Corning 354277) for the monolayer
Corning Matrigel GFR Basement Membrane Matrix, Phenol Red-Free (Corning 356231) for domes
tips: For a new line seed 4,000, 5,000 and 6,000 clumps per well and start all on the same day; too low a density on day 3 gives no spheroids.
Complete growth medium keeps 2 weeks at 2-8°C; thawed basal medium 2 months; supplement aliquots are single-use.
Use a Matrigel lot with at least 8 mg/mL protein and remove all residual medium before embedding, otherwise domes collapse or spheroids sink and attach.
For more differentiated intestinal cell types keep organoids 2 weeks without passaging, feeding every 3-4 days.
pitfalls: Cells lifting during endoderm induction: day 0 density too high or more than 24 h between changes.
Over-pipetting organoids to single cells at passage; fragments should stay 100-500 µm.
Changing the spheroid harvest day between experiments changes regional identity.
unverified: Efficiency: no percentage or organoid yield is stated.

The spheroid harvest day is the user's choice within days 5-9; the stage boundaries here use day 8 (the day the manual says budding is often greatest), so the embedding day and duration_days (day 8 + 7 days to first passage) are illustrative, not fixed by the manual.
The manual calls the seeding day only '24 hours before day 0'; it is labelled day -1 here.
Supplement concentrations (X) for Supplements PK, UB and the Intestinal Organoid Supplement are not printed.
The protocol diagram is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Kidney Organoid Kit (cavitated spheroids, two-stage, 96-well)
kits.principle: Based on Freedman et al. 2015: sparsely seeded single hPSCs are overlaid with Matrigel so they form cavitated spheroids, then Stage 1 medium (Supplement SG, about 36 h) induces late primitive streak and Stage 2 medium (Supplement DM) is fed until day 18, when tubular organoids with podocyte, proximal and distal tubule segments stand up from the adherent layer.
kits.start_requirements: High-quality hPSCs (under 5% differentiation) kept in mTeSR1; lines kept in mTeSR Plus must be in mTeSR1 from day -3 to day 0. On day -3 dissociate with ACCUTASE, filter through a 37 µm strainer and seed 750-3,000 single cells per well of a 96-well plate coated with Matrigel GFR (0.5 mg/mL, 50 µL = 25 µg protein per well) in up to 200 µL mTeSR1 + CloneR2 (1 in 10). No Y-27632 is used.

stages.name: Day -3: single-cell seeding
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1 + CloneR2 (1 in 10 dilution)
stages.feeding: No feeding overnight
actions: Coat 96-well plates with Matrigel diluted to 0.5 mg/mL in cold DMEM/F-12 with 15 mM HEPES (50 µL per well) for at least 1 h at room temperature
Remove differentiated areas, rinse with D-PBS, treat with 0.5 mL ACCUTASE per 6-well for 10 min at 37°C
Collect in DMEM/F-12, pipette 3-4 times, spin 300 x g for 5 min, resuspend in mTeSR1 + CloneR2 and pass through a 37 µm strainer
Count and seed 750-3,000 cells per well with a multichannel pipette (top up to 200 µL); test 750, 1,000, 2,000 and 3,000 for a new line
Let the plate sit 5-10 min in the cabinet before moving it to the incubator

stages.name: Day -2: Matrigel overlay
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1 (cold) + Matrigel at 0.25 mg/mL

factors.name: Corning Matrigel GFR (not in kit)
factors.role: overlay that makes the colonies cavitate

stages.feeding: Single full change, 100 µL per well, for 24 h
actions: Dilute Matrigel into cold mTeSR1 without CloneR2
Remove the medium and immediately add 100 µL of the cold mix per well
Do not touch the well bottom with the tips

stages.name: Day -1: mTeSR1
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1
stages.feeding: Single full change, 100 µL per well, for 1 day
actions: Change to room-temperature mTeSR1
stages.checkpoint: Round, cavitated PSC spheroids (visible from day -1) by day 0

stages.name: Stage 1: late primitive streak
stages.base_medium: Stage 1 Medium (STEMdiff Kidney Basal Medium + STEMdiff Kidney Supplement SG)
stages.feeding: Single 200 µL dose left for 36 h (up to 40 h is acceptable)
actions: Start late on day 0 so that the 36-40 h point falls at a convenient time
Remove mTeSR1 carefully and add 200 µL room-temperature Stage 1 Medium
stages.checkpoint: Day 1.5: heavy cell death, partial detachment and smaller colonies are expected

stages.name: Stage 2: nephron induction and organoid formation
stages.base_medium: Stage 2 Medium (STEMdiff Kidney Basal Medium + STEMdiff Kidney Supplement DM)
stages.feeding: Day 1.5: 200 µL per well; day 4: 100 µL; then 100 µL every 2-3 days (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) to day 18
actions: Day 1.5: remove Stage 1 Medium and add Stage 2 Medium dropwise down the wall of a tilted plate; cells lift easily here
Day 4 and afterwards: full changes of 100 µL
If the medium yellows quickly, feed every 2 days from day 10, double the volume or feed daily
Day 18: use for assays, flow cytometry or fix for staining; cultures can be held about one more week without further development
stages.checkpoint: Day 4: recovering, near-confluent monolayer. Day 8-10: early tubular structures must be visible, otherwise restart. Day 15: dense multi-tubular organoids. Stain PODXL (podocytes), LTL (proximal tubule), ECAD (distal tubule), CD31

materials: STEMdiff Kidney Organoid Kit (05160): Kidney Basal Medium 100 mL, Kidney Supplement SG (100X) 200 µL, Kidney Supplement DM (50X) 1.6 mL
Corning Matrigel GFR Basement Membrane Matrix, Phenol Red-Free (Corning 356231)
96-well flat-bottom tissue culture-treated plate (e.g. 38022); for imaging Corning 96-Well Half-Area High-Content Imaging Microplate (100-0367) or Ibidi µ-Plate 96-well, black (Ibidi 89626)
tips: The optimal single-cell number per well is line-dependent; titrate it once for each line.
Stage 2 Medium keeps 2 weeks at 2-8°C; thawed basal medium keeps 2 months.
Matrigel-coated plates can be sealed and stored up to 7 days at 2-8°C.
Use mTeSR1 for days -3 to 0 even if the line is maintained in mTeSR Plus.
pitfalls: Cells detaching completely after Stage 1: seeding too sparse, or too little Matrigel in the coat or overlay.
No tubular structures by day 8-10 means the run has failed and should be restarted.
Over-confluent wells turn yellow, and organoids darken and lose their tubular shape.
unverified: Efficiency: no percentage or organoid count per well is stated.
Feeding between day 1.5 and day 4: the manual says to incubate 2 days after the day 1.5 change but the next change is listed on day 4 (2.5 days later).
Seeding range: the protocol says 750-3,000 cells per well, while the troubleshooting table suggests testing 1,000-7,000 and a figure legend reports 5,000 cells per well for one line.
CloneR2 is given as a 1 in 10 dilution in the protocol but as '10 µM' in the troubleshooting table.
The protocol diagram is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Lung Progenitor Kit (three stages, replate on day 4)
kits.principle: A serum-free three-stage monolayer protocol: definitive endoderm (days 1-3), anterior foregut endoderm after replating as small clumps (days 4-6) and NKX2.1+ lung progenitors (days 7-15), which can then be matured to proximal or distal airway cells with published protocols.
kits.start_requirements: High-quality hPSCs (under 5% differentiation) in mTeSR1 or mTeSR Plus, about 70% confluent. Clump-passage with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (4-7 min at room temperature, then scrape) and seed 5,000 clumps of 50-200 µm per well of a 24-well plate coated with Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix in 0.5 mL maintenance medium (no ROCK inhibitor at this step). At least 70% confluent 24 h later.

stages.name: Clump seeding (24 h before day 1)
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1 or mTeSR Plus
stages.feeding: No feeding for 24 h; if under 70% confluent, give fresh medium and wait another 24 h
actions: Coat a 24-well tissue culture-treated plate with Matrigel
Remove differentiated areas, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 4-7 min at room temperature and scrape colonies off in medium
Pipette slowly to 50-200 µm clumps, count clumps in 5 µL and seed 5,000 per well
For a new line compare 1,000, 3,000, 5,000 and 7,000 clumps per well
stages.checkpoint: At least 70% confluent with under 5% differentiation

stages.name: Stage 1 day 1: Medium DE-1
stages.base_medium: Medium DE-1 (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium (Lung) + Supplement MR + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Single 0.5 mL per 24-well dose for 24 h
actions: Prepare Medium DE-1 (use at once) and Medium DE-2 (store at 2-8°C)
Replace maintenance medium with room-temperature DE-1

stages.name: Stage 1 days 2-3: Medium DE-2 (definitive endoderm)
stages.base_medium: Medium DE-2 (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium (Lung) + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Daily full change, 0.5 mL per well
actions: Change to DE-2 on day 2 and again on day 3
stages.checkpoint: Some cell death during Stage 1 is expected and allowed for

stages.name: Stage 2: replate in Medium LP-1 (anterior foregut endoderm)
stages.base_medium: Medium LP-1 (LP Basal Medium [STEMdiff Lung Basal Medium + STEMdiff Lung Supplement (10X)] + STEMdiff Lung Progenitor Supplement 1)

factors.name: STEMdiff Lung Basal Medium
factors.role: basal medium (3.15 mL per 3.5 mL LP Basal Medium)

factors.name: Y-27632 (Dihydrochloride) (not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor, day 4 replating aliquot only

stages.feeding: Day 4: replate in 1 mL per well total; day 5: full change to 0.5 mL LP-1 without Y-27632, then leave 48 h
actions: Day 4: coat fresh 24-well plates with Matrigel; prepare LP-1 (split into day 4 and day 5 aliquots) and LP-2
Treat Stage 1 wells with 0.25 mL Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent for 2-4 min at room temperature, aspirate, add 0.5 mL LP-1 + Y-27632 and pipette to clumps of about 10-20 cells
Replate one Stage 1 well into 6-12 new wells that already hold 0.5 mL LP-1 + Y-27632 (83 µL of cells per well for a 1:6 split)
Day 5: change to LP-1 without Y-27632

stages.name: Stage 3: Medium LP-2 (lung progenitors)
stages.base_medium: Medium LP-2 (LP Basal Medium + STEMdiff Lung Progenitor Supplement 2)

factors.name: STEMdiff Lung Basal Medium + STEMdiff Lung Supplement (10X)

stages.feeding: Full change of 0.5 mL per well every other day from day 7 (day 7, 9, ...) until day 15
actions: Change to LP-2 on day 7
Feed every 48 h
Day 15: assay or carry into proximal/distal airway protocols
stages.checkpoint: NKX2.1 expression is the lung progenitor readout

materials: STEMdiff Lung Progenitor Kit (100-0230): Definitive Endoderm Supplement CJ (100X) 1.1 mL and MR (100X) 0.35 mL, Endoderm Basal Medium (Lung) 100 mL, Lung Basal Medium 180 mL, Lung Progenitor Supplement 1 (100X) 0.55 mL, Lung Progenitor Supplement 2 (100X) 1.45 mL, Lung Supplement (10X) 20 mL
tips: The day 4 split ratio is strongly line-dependent: test 1:6, 1:9 and 1:12; lower density usually gives a higher NKX2.1 fraction but fewer cells.
LP Basal Medium keeps 1 month at 2-8°C; thawed supplement aliquots are single-use.
Lung Progenitor Supplement 1 is dissolved in DMSO and is thawed at room temperature; the others are thawed on ice.
pitfalls: Starting below 70% confluence or with differentiated colonies.
Breaking the day 4 sheet into single cells instead of clumps of about 10-20 cells.
Forgetting Y-27632 in the day 4 replating aliquot (it is not used on day 5).
unverified: Efficiency: no NKX2.1 percentage is stated.
The seeding day is not numbered in the PIS (only '24 hours' before day 1); it is labelled day 0 here.
The protocol diagram is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Kit (buds in suspension, then Matrigel sandwich)
kits.principle: Four stages: definitive endoderm (days 0-3) and anterior foregut endoderm (days 3-6) in a clump-seeded monolayer, whose free-floating buds are moved to suspension in BLO-B Medium to form lung bud organoids (days 6-14), which are then embedded in a Matrigel sandwich on Transwell inserts where they branch into proximal- and distal-like airway structures (day 14 onward).
kits.product: STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Kit; STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Maturation Kit
kits.start_requirements: High-quality hPSCs (under 5% differentiation) in mTeSR1 or mTeSR Plus, about 70% confluent. Clump-passage with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (5-8 min at room temperature, then scrape) and seed 3,000 clumps of 50-200 µm per well of a 24-well plate coated with Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix in 1 mL maintenance medium; 10 µM Y-27632 is optional for lines that need it. Start when 30-60% confluent, 24 h later.

stages.name: Clump seeding (24 h before day 0)
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1 or mTeSR Plus

factors.name: Y-27632 (not in kit; optional)
factors.role: may help some lines at seeding

stages.feeding: No feeding for 24 h; if under 30-60% confluent, give fresh medium and wait another 24 h
actions: Coat a 24-well tissue culture-treated plate with Matrigel
Remove differentiated areas, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 5-8 min at room temperature and scrape colonies off
Break into 50-200 µm clumps by flicking the tube or slow pipetting, count clumps in 5 µL and seed 3,000 per well
For mTeSR Plus cultures or new lines compare 1,000, 3,000, 5,000 and 7,000 clumps per well
stages.checkpoint: 30-60% confluent with under 5% differentiation

stages.name: Stage 1 day 0: DE-1 Medium
stages.base_medium: DE-1 Medium (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium (Lung) + Supplement MR + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Single 0.5 mL per 24-well dose for 24 h
actions: Prepare DE-1 and DE-2 on day 0
Replace maintenance medium with room-temperature DE-1

stages.name: Stage 1 days 1-2: DE-2 Medium (definitive endoderm)
stages.base_medium: DE-2 Medium (STEMdiff Endoderm Basal Medium (Lung) + Supplement CJ)
stages.feeding: Daily full change, 0.5 mL per well; feed no later than 26 h after the previous change
actions: Add medium down the side of a tilted plate
Change on day 1 and day 2
stages.checkpoint: Some cell death in Stage 1 is expected and allowed for

stages.name: Stage 2: BLO-A Medium (anterior foregut endoderm)
stages.base_medium: BLO-A Medium (BLO Basal Medium [STEMdiff Lung Basal Medium + STEMdiff Lung Supplement (10X)] + STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Supplement A)

factors.name: STEMdiff Lung Basal Medium
factors.role: basal medium (13.5 mL per 15 mL BLO Basal Medium)

factors.name: STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Supplement A (100X)

stages.feeding: Full change of 0.5 mL per well every 22-26 h on days 3, 4 and 5 (and once more on the monolayer plate on day 6)
actions: Day 3: make BLO Basal Medium and BLO-A Medium
Feed down the side of a tilted plate
Do not aspirate the monolayer even if it starts to peel; it still releases buds
stages.checkpoint: Free-floating anterior foregut endoderm buds may appear on day 5; for most lines wait until day 6 to collect

stages.name: Stage 3: buds in suspension in BLO-B Medium (lung bud organoids)
stages.base_medium: BLO-B Medium (BLO Basal Medium + STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Supplement B)

factors.name: STEMdiff Lung Basal Medium + STEMdiff Lung Supplement (10X)
STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Supplement B (100X)

stages.feeding: 0.5 mL per well; first change after 22-26 h, then every 2 days (one 3-day gap per week allowed)
actions: Day 6: rinse a CELLSTAR 24-well suspension plate with 0.25 mL Anti-Adherence Rinsing Solution per well, then 0.5 mL DMEM/F-12 with 15 mM HEPES
Transfer the floating buds well-to-well with a 1 mL pipette, refeed the monolayer plate with BLO-A, and give the buds BLO-B after letting them settle in a tilted plate
Day 7: collect the second crop of floating buds into the same suspension wells and discard the monolayer plate
Aim for 30-50 buds per well: pool wells with fewer than 30, split or freeze (CryoStor CS10) wells with more than 50
After 7 days in suspension move on to Stage 4 (can be delayed up to day 21)
stages.checkpoint: Some organoid death and fusion is expected; survivors enlarge and develop thicker epithelium with internal structure

stages.name: Stage 4: Matrigel sandwich on Transwell inserts (branching lung organoids)
stages.base_medium: BLO-B Medium

factors.name: STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Supplement B (100X)
factors.role: maturation (composition proprietary); also supplied in the Maturation Kit 100-0528

factors.name: Corning Matrigel GFR, Phenol Red-free (not in kit)
factors.role: three-layer sandwich: 50 µL base, 30 µL with organoids, 50 µL top

stages.feeding: 0.5 mL basal and 0.3 mL apical; change both every 2 days (one 3-day gap per week allowed)
actions: Place 6.5 mm Transwell inserts in a 24-well plate and set a 50 µL Matrigel base layer for at least 10 min at room temperature
Move 1-5 lung bud organoids with a wide-bore tip to a cold tube, remove the medium and mix with 30 µL Matrigel; place on the base layer and set 5-10 min
Cover with a further 50 µL Matrigel and set 15 min at 37°C, then add BLO-B Medium to both chambers
For longer culture (at least 3 months) add a fresh 50 µL Matrigel layer every 4 weeks; extra medium comes from the Maturation Kit (100-0528)
stages.checkpoint: Budding and NKX2.1 expression within 2 weeks of embedding; branching organoids by week 4 (EPCAM, NKX2.1, SOX2, SOX9, MUC1, P63). Beyond 28 days in the sandwich SFTPC, SFTPB and ABCA3 rise

materials: STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Kit (100-0195): Endoderm Basal Medium (Lung) 100 mL, Lung Basal Medium 180 mL, Definitive Endoderm Supplement MR (100X) 0.35 mL and CJ (100X) 1.1 mL, Lung Supplement (10X) 20 mL, Branching Lung Organoid Supplement A (100X) 0.25 mL, Branching Lung Organoid Supplement B (100X) 1.75 mL
STEMdiff Branching Lung Organoid Maturation Kit (100-0528): Lung Basal Medium, Lung Supplement (10X), Branching Lung Organoid Supplement B (100X)
Corning Matrigel GFR Basement Membrane Matrix, Phenol Red-free, LDEV-free (Corning 356231)
Costar 6.5 mm Transwell, 0.4 µm Pore Polyester Membrane Inserts (38024)
Greiner CELLSTAR 24-well suspension culture plates (Sigma Aldrich M9312-100EA)
CryoStor CS10 (07930) for freezing spare buds
tips: One kit covers 12 Transwell inserts for 28 days in the sandwich; buy the Maturation Kit for more inserts or longer culture.
Precipitate in Supplement A is harmless; Supplement B is light sensitive.
Use only free-floating buds; washing buds off the monolayer brings unwanted cells.
BLO Basal Medium keeps 2 months at 2-8°C.
pitfalls: Wrong starting density: this kit wants a sparse 30-60% confluent culture, unlike the other endoderm kits.
Aspirating the peeling monolayer on days 5-7 loses the bud source.
Too many buds per well (over 50) in suspension.
unverified: Efficiency: no percentage or organoid yield is stated.
Stage 3 is headed 'Day 6 - 14' but the text says to proceed 'after 7 days of incubation' in suspension; the heading's day 14 is used here.
duration_days of 42 is day 14 plus the 4 weeks in the sandwich that the PIS says are needed for branching organoids (Stage 4 is headed 'Day 14 - 42+').
The seeding day is not numbered in the PIS; it is labelled day -1 here.
The components are listed as 'Branching Lung Organoid Supplement A/B' but called 'BLO Supplement A/B' in the directions; step 33 refers to step 29 for volumes where step 32 is evidently meant.
The protocol diagram is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Mesenchymal Progenitor Kit (induction, then MesenCult-ACF Plus expansion)
kits.principle: Defined, animal component-free workflow: four days in STEMdiff-ACF Mesenchymal Induction Medium make early mesoderm, two days in MesenCult-ACF Plus Medium follow, and from day 6 the cells are passaged on Animal Component-Free Cell Attachment Substrate until, by day 21, they look and type like mesenchymal progenitor cells with trilineage potential.
kits.efficiency: > 90% of cells express CD73, CD105 and CD146 on day 21
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8, ready for passage (large compact colonies with dense centres). On day -2 plate single cells (Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent) on tissue culture-treated 6-well plates coated with Corning Matrigel (mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus) or Vitronectin XF (TeSR-E8) in 3 mL maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632 at 5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 (mTeSR1 or TeSR-E8 cultures) or 1-2.5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 (mTeSR Plus cultures); about 30-50% confluent on day -1.

stages.name: Phase 1: single-cell plating and recovery
stages.base_medium: TeSR maintenance medium (mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8)
stages.feeding: Day -2: 3 mL plating medium; day -1: change to 2 mL medium without Y-27632
actions: Coat a 6-well plate with Matrigel or Vitronectin XF and bring to room temperature for at least 30 min
Rinse with D-PBS, treat with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent 8-10 min at 37°C and pipette to single cells
Spin 300 x g for 5 min, count and plate at the density for your maintenance medium
Seed spare wells for qPCR on day 4 and flow cytometry on day 21
stages.checkpoint: About 30-50% confluent on day -1

stages.name: Phase 2: early mesoderm induction
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff-ACF Mesenchymal Induction Medium (complete as supplied)
stages.feeding: Daily full change, 3 mL per 6-well, on days 0, 1, 2 and 3
actions: Day 0: wash once with 1 mL D-PBS and add room-temperature induction medium
Change daily
stages.checkpoint: Day 4 qPCR: Brachyury, NCAM and MIXL1 up; OCT4, SOX2, NANOG and EpCAM down

stages.name: Phase 3a: switch to MesenCult-ACF Plus
stages.base_medium: Complete MesenCult-ACF Plus Medium (MesenCult-ACF Plus Medium + 500X Supplement + 2 mM L-Glutamine)
stages.feeding: 2 mL per 6-well on day 4 and day 5
actions: Warm the medium to room temperature only, never at 37°C
Day 4: wash once with D-PBS and change to complete MesenCult-ACF Plus
Day 5: change again

stages.name: Phase 3b: passage and expand on ACF attachment substrate
stages.base_medium: Complete MesenCult-ACF Plus Medium
stages.feeding: After the day 6 passage: daily half-medium changes for about 3-6 days; from passage 2 no routine changes unless cells begin to detach
actions: Day 6: detach with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (8-10 min at 37°C, scrape any stragglers), spin 300 x g for 7 min in polypropylene tubes and plate at 1.5-10 x 10^3 cells/cm2 in 3 mL medium + 10 µM Y-27632 on substrate-coated tissue culture-treated plates
Passage at about 80% confluence, every 3-6 days
From the second passage use the Animal Component-Free Cell Dissociation Kit (enzyme 3-6 min at 37°C, never over 7 min, then inhibitor), spin 300 x g for 8 min and plate in 2 mL without Y-27632
Plating density falls with passage: 3-8 x 10^3 (passage 1-2), 1.5-6 x 10^3 (2-3), 1.5-3 x 10^3 cells/cm2 (3-4 and later)
stages.checkpoint: Day 21 (about passage 5-6): spindle MPC-like cells, > 90% CD73+ CD105+ CD146+, negative for CD45, CD34, CD144 and CD31; OCT4 and TRA-1-60 absent

materials: STEMdiff Mesenchymal Progenitor Kit (05240): STEMdiff-ACF Mesenchymal Induction Medium 100 mL, MesenCult-ACF Plus Medium 500 mL, MesenCult-ACF Plus 500X Supplement 1 mL, Animal Component-Free Cell Attachment Substrate 1 mL
Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix (Corning 354277) or Vitronectin XF (07180)
tips: Use polypropylene tubes during subculture so the cells do not stick.
Complete MesenCult-ACF Plus Medium keeps only 1 week at 2-8°C and must not be frozen; thawed induction medium keeps 1 month.
Adipogenic differentiation of PSC-derived MPCs works best after day 40 (passage 10 or later); MesenCult differentiation media: adipogenic 05412, osteogenic 05465, chondrogenic 05455.
Use only tissue culture-treated cultureware.
pitfalls: Warming MesenCult-ACF Plus or the dissociation reagents at 37°C; the PIS says room temperature only.
Leaving cells in the ACF enzyme for more than 7 minutes.
Lines kept in mTeSR Plus need a lower plating density (1-2.5 x 10^4 cells/cm2) than those in mTeSR1 or TeSR-E8.
unverified: mTeSR Plus catalogue number: this PIS prints 05825, whereas the other STEMCELL sheets in this set print 100-0276; left out of the materials line.
The exact days of each passage between day 6 and day 21 are not fixed (every 3-6 days at about 80% confluence).
The extracted text has scrambled step numbers in places (table and numbered lists merged), so step cross-references could not be checked.
The protocol diagram is an image and was not available.

kits.name: STEMdiff Myogenic Progenitor Supplement Kit (Media A-D for 30 days, then MyoCult)
kits.principle: Four serum-free supplements, each diluted in DMEM/F-12, are applied in sequence with daily feeding (A days 0-1, B days 2-3, C days 4-5, D days 6-29) to turn a sparse hPSC monolayer into a dense multilayered culture of CD56+ CD82+ myogenic progenitors. On day 30 the cells are dissociated, expanded in MyoCult-SF Expansion Medium and can be fused into MyHC+ myotubes with MyoCult Differentiation Medium.
kits.start_requirements: High-quality hPSCs (strong OCT4 and TRA-1-60) kept as clumps in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 on Corning Matrigel-coated 6-well plates. On day -1 dissociate to single cells with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent and plate 30,000-40,000 cells/cm2 on Matrigel in 2 mL maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632. Colonies must contain about 10-30 cells on day 0.

stages.name: Day -1: single-cell plating
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 + 10 µM Y-27632

factors.name: Y-27632 (Dihydrochloride) (not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor, first 24 h after replating

Myotube differentiation (timing depends on expansion): Seed progenitors at 80,000 cells per 12-well (20,000 cells/cm2) on Matrigel in MyoCult-SF Expansion Medium and feed every other day At 95-100% confluence wash with D-PBS and add 1.5 mL MyoCult Differentiation Medium After 5 days replace half the medium and continue for up to 5 days Feeding: 1.5 mL per 12-well left for 5 days, then one half-change (0.75 mL) and up to 5 more days

Myotube stage: its start depends on how long expansion takes, so it is folded into the day-30 stage as an action; the PIS gives 5 days in MyoCult Differentiation Medium plus up to 5 more after a half-change, preceded by an unspecified time to reach 95-100% confluence.
Composition and preparation of MyoCult-SF Expansion Medium and MyoCult Differentiation Medium are in their own sheets, not in this PIS.

kits.name: STEMdiff SMADi Neural Induction (monolayer protocol)
kits.principle: Single hPSCs are plated at very high density and kept in neural induction medium with a dual-SMAD-inhibiting supplement, which pushes them to CNS-type neural progenitors and suppresses non-CNS fates. Three passages in the same medium yield expandable PAX6/SOX1/Nestin-positive NPCs.
kits.efficiency: Expected by ICC: PAX6, SOX1 and Nestin each ≥ 80 - 90%; SOX10 (neural crest) ≤ 10%; OCT4 negligible
kits.start_requirements: High-quality feeder-free hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus, TeSR-E8 or TeSR-AOF (SMADi supplement highly recommended for TeSR-E8 cells). Dissociate to single cells with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (8 - 10 min, 37°C) and plate 2 x 10^5 cells/cm2 (2 x 10^6 cells in 2 mL per well of a 6-well plate; 2 - 2.5 x 10^5 cells/cm2 recommended) on PLO/laminin (15 µg/mL PLO, 10 µg/mL laminin) or Matrigel, in induction medium with 10 µM Y-27632.

kits.name: STEMdiff SMADi Neural Induction (embryoid body protocol)
kits.principle: hPSCs are aggregated into uniform 10,000-cell embryoid bodies in AggreWell800 plates in SMAD-inhibiting induction medium, then plated so that neural rosettes form. Rosettes are lifted selectively with a non-enzymatic selection reagent and replated to give CNS-type NPCs.
kits.efficiency: Expected by ICC: PAX6, SOX1 and Nestin each ≥ 80 - 90%; SOX10 (neural crest) ≤ 10%; OCT4 negligible. Rosette selection works best when ≥ 75% of attached EBs are rosette-rich on day 8
kits.start_requirements: High-quality feeder-free hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 (SMADi supplement highly recommended for TeSR-E8 cells). Dissociate to single cells with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent and seed 3 x 10^6 cells per well of an AggreWell800 24-well plate (10,000 cells per microwell) pre-treated with Anti-Adherence Rinsing Solution, in induction medium with 10 µM Y-27632 (2 mL final per well).

stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Neural Induction Medium + SMADi

factors.role: blocks TGF-β/BMP-dependent SMAD signalling; 0.5 mL per 250 mL medium (composition proprietary)

factors.name: STEMdiff Neural Rosette Selection Reagent
factors.role: day 12 only: selective detachment of rosettes (1 mL per well, 1.5 h at 37°C with SMADi; 1 h without)

stages.feeding: Daily full medium change (2 mL per well) from day 13 until passage
actions: Day 12: wash with DMEM/F-12, add 1 mL selection reagent and incubate 1.5 h at 37°C
Remove the reagent and dislodge rosette clusters by aiming 1 mL DMEM/F-12 at them with a standard tip; do not break them up
Spin 350 x g for 5 min, resuspend gently in 2 mL medium and plate into one freshly coated well of a 6-well plate
Passage NPCs with ACCUTASE at about day 17 - 19 into STEMdiff Neural Progenitor Medium or a downstream kit
stages.checkpoint: Clusters attach and NPCs fill the gaps as a monolayer within 2 - 5 days; ready for passage 1 at about day 17 - 19

37 µm Reversible Strainer (27215 small or 27250 large)
Poly-L-ornithine (Sigma P4957) and laminin (Sigma L2020) or Corning Matrigel hESC-Qualified Matrix (Corning 354277)
ACCUTASE (07920) and STEMdiff Neural Progenitor Medium (05833) for NPC passaging
tips: Heavy cell death on day 13, the day after selection, is typical and does not reduce the final NPC yield.
Do not over-select rosettes: leaving some behind costs a little yield but keeps non-CNS cells out.
The selection-reagent incubation time may need optimising per line.
The forebrain neuron PIS quotes an average of 3 NPCs per input hPSC for this EB route (27 for the monolayer route).
pitfalls: Breaking EBs into small clusters or single cells when harvesting or plating causes cell death and low NPC yield; use wide-bore tips.
More than 20,000 cells per microwell overflows the microwells; 10,000 is recommended.
Fast pipetting or shaking the plate during feeds dislodges EBs from the microwells.
unverified: Protocol schematic (manual Figure 1) is an image; day numbers here come from the written steps only.
Downstream kit sheets describe rosette selection on day 11 - 12; the manual's protocol heading says day 12.

kits.name: STEMdiff Forebrain Neuron Differentiation + Maturation
kits.product: STEMdiff Forebrain Neuron Differentiation Kit; STEMdiff Forebrain Neuron Maturation Kit
kits.principle: CNS-type NPCs made with the SMADi neural induction kit are turned into forebrain neuron precursors over 6 days in differentiation medium, then replated and matured for at least 14 days in a BrainPhys-based medium into a mixed population of excitatory and inhibitory FOXG1-positive neurons.
kits.start_requirements: Starts from NPCs, not hPSCs: generate them with STEMdiff SMADi Neural Induction Kit (Catalog #08581) by the monolayer protocol (passage 3, day 18 - 21) or the EB protocol (after rosette selection, day 11/12); NPCs expanded for ≤ 5 passages or thawed NPCs in STEMdiff Neural Progenitor Medium (05833) also work. Plate single NPCs (ACCUTASE) at 80,000 - 125,000 cells/cm2 on PLO/laminin (15 µg/mL PLO, 5 µg/mL laminin) in 2 mL per well of a 6-well plate for 24 h before switching medium. Day numbers follow the PIS, which counts from day 0 of neural induction with STEMdiff SMADi Neural Induction Kit (monolayer route shown; where the PIS gives a range, the earliest day is used). duration_days counts from NPC plating.

Expanded or thawed NPCs are plated in STEMdiff Neural Progenitor Medium instead

stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Forebrain Neuron Maturation Medium

factors.name: STEMdiff Forebrain Neuron Maturation Supplement
factors.role: maturation supplement, 25 mL per 125 mL (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Full medium change every 2 - 3 days; switch to half changes every other day if cells lift
actions: Detach precursors with ACCUTASE (5 - 10 min), spin 300 x g for 5 min and count
Seed 4 - 8 x 10^4 cells/cm2 on PLO/laminin in the final vessel (1.5 - 3 x 10^4 cells/cm2 for cultures > 30 days or for ICC)
Mature for at least 14 days; cultures can be kept up to 12 weeks
stages.checkpoint: After 14 days of maturation check FOXG1, class III β-tubulin, MAP2 and synaptophysin by ICC; GFAP should be low

materials: STEMdiff Forebrain Neuron Differentiation Kit (08600, 100 mL; 100-1691, 500 mL)
STEMdiff Forebrain Neuron Maturation Kit (08605, 125 mL; 100-1659, 625 mL)
STEMdiff Neural Progenitor Medium (05833) if starting from expanded or frozen NPCs
CryoStor CS10 (07930) for optional freezing of precursors
tips: Both complete media keep up to 4 weeks at 2 - 8°C; protect the BrainPhys-based maturation medium from light.
NPC and precursor seeding densities need optimising per line and per application.
Thawed precursors are typically 70 - 90% viable; add 10 µM Y-27632 during resuspension and plating if recovery is poor.
One differentiation kit gives on average 20 million precursors; one maturation kit supports up to 4.5 million neurons for 14 days.
pitfalls: Neurons generally cannot be passaged once maturation has begun, so seed precursors straight into the final cultureware.
Fast medium changes detach neurons: add medium dropwise against the vessel wall.
NPCs expanded beyond 5 passages differentiate less well.
unverified: No purity percentage for the neurons is given in the PIS, so efficiency is null.
The two protocol diagrams are images; days come from the written steps (EB route: differentiation medium day 12/13, passage day 18/19; monolayer route: day 19 - 22 and day 25 - 28).
Day 39 is day 25 plus the stated minimum of 14 days of maturation; the PIS does not print that day number.

kits.name: STEMdiff Midbrain Neuron Differentiation + Maturation
kits.product: STEMdiff Midbrain Neuron Differentiation Kit; STEMdiff Midbrain Neuron Maturation Kit
kits.principle: NPCs from the SMADi neural induction kit are patterned to midbrain neuronal precursors in differentiation medium supplemented with recombinant Shh, then replated and matured for at least 2 weeks in a BrainPhys-based medium to give neurons that include TH-positive dopaminergic cells.
kits.efficiency: ≥ 15% TH-positive dopaminergic neurons; ≥ 90% class III β-tubulin-positive neurons; < 10% GFAP-positive astrocytes
kits.start_requirements: Starts from NPCs, not hPSCs: generate them with STEMdiff SMADi Neural Induction Kit (Catalog #08581). Monolayer route: passage day 18 - 21 (passage 3) NPCs with ACCUTASE and seed 80,000 - 125,000 cells/cm2 on PLO/laminin (15 µg/mL PLO, 10 µg/mL laminin) in 2 mL induction medium for 24 h. EB route: midbrain medium is applied much earlier, on day 6, one day after EBs are replated. Day numbers follow the PIS, which counts from day 0 of neural induction with STEMdiff SMADi Neural Induction Kit (monolayer route shown; where the PIS gives a range, the earliest day is used). duration_days counts from NPC plating.

kits.efficiency: > 40% mature motor neurons. Expected by ICC: day 14 class III β-tubulin > 80%, ISL1 > 40%, NKX6.1 > 40%; day 28 class III β-tubulin > 80%, ISL1 > 40%, HB9/MNX1 > 40%, ChAT > 40%

kits.name: STEMdiff Choroid Plexus Organoid Differentiation + Maturation
kits.product: STEMdiff Choroid Plexus Organoid Differentiation Kit; STEMdiff Choroid Plexus Organoid Maturation Kit
kits.principle: Five-stage protocol based on Pellegrini et al.: hPSC aggregates are formed in 96-well U-bottom plates, neurally induced, embedded in Matrigel to expand neuroepithelium, patterned for 5 days to choroid plexus epithelium, then matured on an orbital shaker until fluid-filled cysts lined by TTR/CLIC6/AQP1-positive epithelium appear.
kits.efficiency: > 70% success rate for obtaining organoids with cystic structures by day 30 (varies with cell line)
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs no more than 70 - 80% confluent with < 10% differentiation (maintenance medium not specified in this PIS). Dissociate one well of a 6-well plate with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (8 - 10 min) and seed 9000 cells in 100 µL per well of a 96-well round-bottom ultra-low attachment plate, in Organoid Formation Medium with 10 µM Y-27632. No matrix at seeding; Matrigel is used for embedding on day 7.

kits.name: STEMdiff Ventricular Cardiomyocyte Kit (monolayer, 15 days)
kits.principle: A confluent hPSC monolayer is taken through three proprietary differentiation media (A, B, C) over 8 days and then held in a maintenance medium, giving beating cTnT+ ventricular cardiomyocytes ready to harvest on day 15.
kits.efficiency: Greater than 80% cTnT+ cells; on average 1 x 10^6 cells harvested per well of a 12-well plate
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs kept as clump cultures in mTeSR1 (Catalog #85850), mTeSR Plus (Catalog #100-0276), TeSR-AOF (Catalog #100-0401) or TeSR-E8 (Catalog #05990) on Corning Matrigel (6-well plates), with high OCT4 and TRA-1-60 expression. Dissociate to single cells with Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (8-10 min, 37°C) and seed on day -2 at 3.5 - 8 x 10^5 cells per well of a Matrigel-coated 12-well plate in 1 mL TeSR medium + 10 µM Y-27632; Y-27632 is removed on day -1. Wells must be > 95% confluent after 48 h before day 0.

kits.name: STEMdiff Endothelial Differentiation and Expansion Kits (monolayer)
kits.principle: Sparsely seeded hPSCs get 2 days of STEMdiff Mesoderm Induction Medium (bought separately) and then 4 days of Endothelial Induction Medium, giving CD31+CD34+CD144+ cells by day 7 without sorting. Passaging in Endothelial Expansion Medium on an animal component-free substrate then purifies and expands them.
kits.product: STEMdiff Endothelial Differentiation Kit; STEMdiff Endothelial Expansion Medium Kit; STEMdiff Endothelial Expansion Culture Kit
kits.efficiency: By day 7, 50 - 80% of cells are positive for CD31, CD34 and CD144 (assessment section: > 50%, CD45 negative); typically ≥ 99% CD144+CD31+ by passage 2 in expansion medium
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 on Corning Matrigel, confluent and ready to passage. On day 0 seed single cells on a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate in the maintenance medium + 10 µM Y-27632 at 5000 - 10,000 cells/cm2 (mTeSR1 or TeSR-E8; e.g. 5 - 10 x 10^4 per well) or 3500 - 7500 cells/cm2 (mTeSR Plus; e.g. 3.5 - 7.5 x 10^4 per well).

stages.name: hPSC seeding
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 (the medium used for maintenance)

Seed 5000 - 10,000 cells/cm2 (3500 - 7500 for mTeSR Plus cultures) on a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate

stages.name: Mesoderm induction
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Mesoderm Induction Medium

factors.name: STEMdiff Mesoderm Induction Medium
factors.role: day 1-3 medium, separate product Catalog #05220 (composition proprietary)

Aspirate and add 3 mL slowly down the side of the well
Repeat after 24 h
stages.checkpoint: Some cell loss is expected at this stage

stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Endothelial Induction Medium
stages.feeding: 4 mL per well on day 3, replaced with 4 mL fresh medium on day 5
actions: Thaw the induction medium (2-8°C overnight or room temperature)
Add 4 mL/well slowly down the side of the well
Check morphology daily
stages.checkpoint: Day 7 flow cytometry: > 50% CD34+, CD31+, CD144+ and CD45 negative; OCT4 and TRA-1-60 can be used to confirm that no undifferentiated cells remain

stages.name: Harvest and first subculture
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Endothelial Expansion Medium

factors.name: STEMdiff Endothelial Expansion 5X Supplement
factors.role: expansion supplement, 20 mL per 100 mL (composition proprietary)

factors.name: Animal Component-Free Cell Attachment Substrate
factors.role: plate coating, diluted 1 in 100 in D-PBS, at least 2 h at room temperature

stages.feeding: Full change after 3 days if not yet confluent
actions: Coat the new vessel with diluted ACF Cell Attachment Substrate (1 mL/well of a 6-well plate), wash twice with D-PBS
Detach with room-temperature ACCUTASE, 1 mL/well, 4-5 min at 37°C (never more than 7 min)
Spin 300 x g 5 min, resuspend in Expansion Medium and count
Replate at 10,000 cells/cm2 (workable range 5000 - 15,000), 2 mL/well of a 6-well plate
stages.checkpoint: 90 - 100% confluent monolayer, expected 3-5 days after plating at 10,000 cells/cm2

stages.name: Passaging and expansion
stages.base_medium: STEMdiff Endothelial Expansion Medium

factors.name: STEMdiff Endothelial Expansion 5X Supplement
factors.role: expansion supplement, 20 mL per 100 mL (composition proprietary)

factors.name: Animal Component-Free Cell Attachment Substrate
factors.role: plate coating, diluted 1 in 100 in D-PBS, at least 2 h at room temperature

stages.feeding: Full change after 3 days if not yet confluent; passage at 90 - 100% confluency
actions: Coat flasks or plates with ACF Cell Attachment Substrate
Detach with the Animal Component-Free Cell Dissociation Kit: enzymatic solution 4-5 min at 37°C, then an equal volume of inhibition solution

kits.name: STEMdiff Hematopoietic Kit (2D, 12 days)
kits.principle: Sparse hPSC colonies are pushed to mesoderm for 3 days with Supplement A and then to hematopoietic progenitors for 9 days with Supplement B; CD34+CD45+ progenitors bud off the adherent layer and are collected from the supernatant on day 12.
kits.efficiency: Day 12 supernatant cells typically contain 25 - 65% (average 43%) CD34+CD45+ progenitor cells; typically > 75% of all hematopoietic progenitors are recovered in the supernatant
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 on Corning Matrigel. On day -1 passage as aggregates of 100 - 200 µm (Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent, ReLeSR or Dispase) and plate 40 - 80 aggregates per well of a Matrigel-coated 12-well plate (10 - 20 aggregates/cm2) in 1 mL of maintenance medium, aiming for 16 - 40 attached colonies per well (4 - 10 colonies/cm2) 24 h later. No ROCK inhibitor is specified; cells are not single-cell seeded.

stages.name: Aggregate seeding
stages.base_medium: mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 (the medium used for maintenance)
stages.feeding: None; leave undisturbed for 24 h
actions: Coat a 12-well plate with Matrigel
Passage hPSCs as 100 - 200 µm aggregates and count aggregates ≥ 50 µm in triplicate 5 µL samples
Plate 40 - 80 aggregates per well (10 - 20 per cm2); if working by split ratio, 1 in 40 to 1 in 200
Distribute with short back-and-forth and side-to-side motions and do not disturb for 24 h
stages.checkpoint: Day 0: 16 - 40 attached colonies per well (4 - 10 per cm2), counting even tiny colonies; do not proceed outside this range

stages.name: Stage 1: mesoderm induction (Medium A)
stages.base_medium: Medium A (STEMdiff Hematopoietic Basal Medium + Supplement A)
stages.feeding: Day 0 full change to 1 mL; day 2 half change (remove and add 0.5 mL)
actions: Confirm the colony count, then replace TeSR medium with 1 mL Medium A per well
On day 2 gently remove 0.5 mL and add 0.5 mL fresh Medium A
stages.checkpoint: By day 3 mesodermal cells are migrating outward from the colonies

stages.name: Stage 2: hematopoietic differentiation (Medium B)
stages.base_medium: Medium B (STEMdiff Hematopoietic Basal Medium + Supplement B)
stages.feeding: Day 3 full change to 1 mL; half changes (0.5 mL) on days 5, 7 and 10
actions: Day 3: aspirate and add 1 mL Medium B per well
Days 5, 7, 10: keep the plate flat, remove 0.5 mL without disturbing floating cells, add 0.5 mL Medium B
Day 12: pipette vigorously to release the floating cells, collect, rinse the well twice with 1 mL DMEM/F-12, spin 300 x g 5 min
Optional: recover extra progenitors from the adherent layer with 0.5 mL ACCUTASE for 20 min at 37°C (do not scrape)
stages.checkpoint: Round floating cells appear from about day 7 and increase until day 12; assess CD34, CD45, CD43 by flow cytometry or run CFU assays (MethoCult SF H4636)

materials: STEMdiff Hematopoietic Kit (Catalog #05310): Hematopoietic Basal Medium, Supplement A (200X), Supplement B (200X)
Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (Catalog #100-0485), ReLeSR (Catalog #05872 as printed on this sheet) or Dispase (1 U/mL) (Catalog #07923)
MethoCult SF H4636 (Catalog #04636) for CFU assays
tips: Test several aggregate plating densities; the right number is line-dependent
Cells can be harvested on day 10: yield and CD34+CD45+ fraction are much lower but CFU frequency may be higher
Complete Medium A or B keeps 4 weeks at 2-8°C or 6 months at -20°C
For CFU assays plate about 5000 viable day-12 cells (3000 for day 10) per 35 mm dish
pitfalls: Starting with fewer or more attached colonies than the stated window (4 - 10 per cm2) compromises differentiation
Disturbing or aspirating the floating cell layer during half-medium changes from day 7
Scraping residual colonies at the adherent harvest: the clumps will not dissociate
unverified: Composition of Supplements A and B is proprietary
The protocol diagram is an image; its caption text was available and matches the written steps
ReLeSR is listed as Catalog #05872 on this sheet but as #100-0484 on the monocyte, megakaryocyte and erythroid sheets

kits.name: STEMdiff Monocyte Kit (CD14+ monocytes, the macrophage precursor)
kits.principle: A 2D culture goes through mesoderm (Medium A, 3 days) and hematopoietic (Medium B, 4 days) stages and is then kept in Monocyte Differentiation Medium, where CD14+ monocytes are shed into the supernatant and can be collected repeatedly from day 14. The kit stops at monocytes, the precursor of macrophages; the sheet itself does not describe a macrophage step.
kits.efficiency: Peak CD14+ frequency typically 60 - 80%; maximum CD14+ output generally between day 17 and day 22
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 on Corning Matrigel. On day -1 passage as aggregates of 100 - 200 µm (Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent, ReLeSR or Dispase) and plate 100 - 200 aggregates per well of a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate (10 - 20 aggregates/cm2) in 2 mL of maintenance medium, aiming for 40 - 100 attached colonies per well (4 - 10 colonies/cm2) 24 h later. No ROCK inhibitor is specified; cells are not single-cell seeded.

stages.name: Stage 2: hematopoietic specification (Medium B)
stages.base_medium: Medium B (STEMdiff Hematopoietic Basal Medium + Supplement B)

factors.name: STEMdiff Hematopoietic Supplement B (200X)
factors.role: day 3-7 supplement, 1 in 200 (component #05323 in this kit; composition proprietary)

stages.name: Stage 3: monocyte differentiation
stages.base_medium: Monocyte Differentiation Medium (StemSpan SFEM II + STEMdiff Monocyte Differentiation Supplement)

factors.name: STEMdiff Monocyte Differentiation Supplement (100X)
factors.role: day 7 onward supplement, 1 mL per 100 mL (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Full changes, 2 mL per well: day 7, day 9 or 10, day 11 or 12

Day 14: first optional harvest (or just change medium)
stages.checkpoint: Floating cells are usually visible from day 9-10 and keep increasing

stages.name: Repeated monocyte harvests
stages.base_medium: Monocyte Differentiation Medium (StemSpan SFEM II + STEMdiff Monocyte Differentiation Supplement)
stages.feeding: Every 2-3 days: either harvest and refeed with 2 mL, or full change without harvesting
actions: Take off all medium, use it to rinse loosely attached monocytes from the well, and collect
Refeed the well with 2 mL Monocyte Differentiation Medium
Spin the collected cells 300 x g 5 min and resuspend for assays
To collect more per harvest, feed 4 mL or top up with 2 mL without removing medium so cells accumulate over 3-4 days
stages.checkpoint: CD14+ purity by flow cytometry; peak frequency typically 60 - 80%, highest yield between day 17 and day 22
