kits.name: STEMdiff NK Cell Kit (EBs to CD34+ cells to CD56+ NK cells)
kits.principle: hPSC embryoid bodies made in AggreWell400 plates are differentiated for 12 days to CD34+ hematopoietic progenitors, which are magnetically selected and cultured on a lymphoid coating material: 14 days to CD7+CD5+ lymphoid progenitors, then 14 days in NK differentiation medium with UM729 to CD56+ NK cells. Serum-free and feeder-free.
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-E8 (the manual works from a 100 mm dish; matrix is not named in the protocol chapter), with differentiated areas removed. Dissociate to single cells with ACCUTASE and seed 3.5 x 10^6 cells per well of an AggreWell400 6-well plate (500 cells per microwell) in 5 mL EB Formation Medium containing 10 µM Y-27632, then centrifuge at 100 x g for 3 min. No confluency requirement is stated.

stages.name: EB formation and mesoderm induction (EB protocol days 0-3)
stages.base_medium: EB Formation Medium (EB Medium A + 10 µM Y-27632), then EB Medium A

factors.name: Y-27632
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor in EB Formation Medium on day 0

stages.feeding: Day 2: half change (2.5 mL) with EB Medium A; day 3: half change with EB Medium B
actions: Pre-treat an AggreWell400 6-well plate with Anti-Adherence Rinsing Solution
Dissociate hPSCs with ACCUTASE (about 10 min at 37°C) to single cells and count
Add 3.5 x 10^6 cells per well in 5 mL EB Formation Medium (500 cells per microwell) and spin 100 x g for 3 min
Leave 2 days, then do the half changes slowly from the top of the well without lifting the EBs
stages.checkpoint: Uniform EBs in the microwells, usually within 24 h (some lines need up to 72 h)

stages.name: Hematopoietic specification in EB Medium B (EB protocol days 3-12)
stages.base_medium: EB Medium B (STEMdiff Hematopoietic - EB Basal Medium + Supplement B)
stages.feeding: Day 5: transfer EBs in 2.5 mL; day 7: add 2.5 mL; day 10: half change (2.5 mL)
actions: Day 5: flush EBs out of the microwells, catch them on a 37 µm reversible strainer, and wash them into 2.5 mL EB Medium B
Plate into one well of a non-tissue culture-treated 6-well plate and spread evenly
Day 7: add 2.5 mL EB Medium B; day 10: replace half the medium
stages.checkpoint: Loosely attached EBs with some adherent outgrowth are acceptable; avoid large fused clumps

stages.name: Lymphoid progenitor expansion (lymphoid protocol days 0-14)
stages.base_medium: StemSpan Lymphoid Progenitor Expansion Medium (StemSpan SFEM II + Lymphoid Progenitor Expansion Supplement)

factors.name: StemSpan Lymphoid Differentiation Coating Material (100X)
factors.role: plate coating, 1 in 100 in D-PBS, 2 h at room temperature or overnight at 2-8°C

stages.feeding: Lymphoid day 3 or 4: add 500 µL; day 7: half change plus transfer to a freshly coated well; day 10 or 11: half change (keep a 3-4 day rhythm)
actions: EB day 12: collect EBs, spin 300 x g, digest in 1 mL Collagenase Type II (2500 U/mL) for 20 min at 37°C, then add 3 mL TrypLE Express for another 20 min
Dilute with 6 mL DMEM/F-12, spin, strain if clumpy, and isolate CD34+ cells with EasySep Human CD34 Positive Selection Kit II (ES/iPS protocol, 2 magnet separations)
Coat a non-tissue culture-treated 24-well plate with Lymphoid Differentiation Coating Material (500 µL/well) and rinse with D-PBS
Seed 2.5 x 10^4 CD34+ cells per well in 500 µL (5 x 10^4 CD34+ cells/mL)
Lymphoid day 7: after the half change, gently resuspend the non-adherent cells and move them to a freshly coated well (earlier if adherent cells pass 50% confluence)
Lymphoid day 14: resuspend and harvest; cells can be frozen here in CryoStor CS10
stages.checkpoint: EB day 12 before selection: ≥ 15% CD34+ and ≥ 1 x 10^5 CD34+ cells per AggreWell400 6-well well; after selection > 50% CD34+. Lymphoid day 14: typically ≥ 20% CD5+CD7+ cells and ≥ 5 CD5+CD7+ cells per input CD34+ cell

stages.name: NK cell differentiation (lymphoid protocol days 14-28)
stages.base_medium: StemSpan NK Cell Differentiation Medium (StemSpan SFEM II + NK Cell Differentiation Supplement + UM729)
stages.feeding: Lymphoid day 17 or 18: add 500 µL; day 21 and day 24 or 25: half changes (500 µL)
actions: Count the day-14 lymphoid cells and reseed 5 x 10^4 cells per well in 500 µL (1 x 10^5 cells/mL)
Use a tissue culture-treated, non-coated 24-well plate for this stage
Feed on the 3-4 day rhythm
Lymphoid day 28: resuspend and harvest the NK cells
stages.checkpoint: Flow cytometry for CD56 (plus CD16, CD94, NKp46, NKp44, NKp30, NKG2D, KIR as needed)

materials: STEMdiff NK Cell Kit (Catalog #100-0170): Hematopoietic - EB Basal Medium (#100-0171), EB Supplement A (#100-0172), EB Supplement B (#100-0173), StemSpan Lymphoid Progenitor Expansion Supplement (10X) (#09915), Lymphoid Differentiation Coating Material (100X) (#09925), NK Cell Differentiation Supplement (100X) (#09950), StemSpan SFEM II (#09605)
EasySep Human CD34 Positive Selection Kit II (Catalog #17856)
Non-tissue culture-treated 6-well and 24-well plates (e.g. Catalog #38040 and #38042)
Tissue culture-treated 24-well plate (e.g. Catalog #38017) for the NK stage
tips: EB size strongly affects CD34+ output and is line-dependent: titrate the cells per microwell if CD34+ frequency is low
Seeding by total cell number instead of CD34+ number is acceptable if flow cytometry would delay plating
Feeding days can shift as long as the 3-4 day interval is kept; if wells become confluent, remove half the medium with cells and replace with fresh medium
Complete NK Cell Differentiation Medium keeps up to 3 weeks at 2-8°C; Lymphoid Progenitor Expansion Medium up to 1 month; EB media 2 weeks
pitfalls: Adherent cell overgrowth (≥ 50% of the surface) blocks contact with the coating material: move the suspension cells to a freshly coated well

Extending the EB culture to gain more CD34+ cells may reduce lymphoid potential

Composition of all supplements and of the coating material is proprietary

Dilute with 6 mL DMEM/F-12, spin, strain if clumpy, and isolate CD34+ cells with EasySep Human CD34 Positive Selection Kit II (ES/iPS protocol, 2 magnet separations)
Coat a non-tissue culture-treated 24-well plate with Lymphoid Differentiation Coating Material (500 µL/well) and rinse with D-PBS
Seed 2.5 x 10^4 CD34+ cells per well in 500 µL (5 x 10^4 CD34+ cells/mL)
Lymphoid day 7: after the half change, gently resuspend the non-adherent cells and move them to a freshly coated well (earlier if adherent cells pass 50% confluence)
Lymphoid day 14: resuspend and harvest; cells can be frozen here in CryoStor CS10
stages.checkpoint: EB day 12 before selection: ≥ 15% CD34+ and ≥ 1 x 10^5 CD34+ cells per AggreWell400 6-well well; after selection > 50% CD34+. Lymphoid day 14: typically ≥ 20% CD5+CD7+ cells and ≥ 5 CD5+CD7+ cells per input CD34+ cell

kits.name: STEMdiff Megakaryocyte Kit (2D, 17 days)
kits.principle: Sparse hPSC colonies are differentiated for 12 days into megakaryocyte-biased hematopoietic progenitors (Supplement A for 3 days, then Supplement MK1 for 9 days); the floating progenitors are then replated for 5 days in StemSpan SFEM II + Supplement MK2 to mature into polyploid CD41a+CD42b+ megakaryocytes that can shed platelets.
kits.efficiency: At day 17 the average frequency of viable CD41a+CD42b+ cells is 56 - 77%, with an average of 223 - 425 CD41a+CD42b+ cells per seeded hPSC (n > 12, four ES/iPS lines; line-dependent)
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained in mTeSR1, mTeSR Plus or TeSR-AOF on Corning Matrigel. On day -1 passage as aggregates of 100 - 200 µm (Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent, ReLeSR or Dispase) and plate 40 - 80 aggregates per well of a Matrigel-coated 12-well tissue culture-treated plate (10 - 20 aggregates/cm2) in 1 mL of maintenance medium, aiming for 16 - 40 attached colonies per well (4 - 10 colonies/cm2) 24 h later. No ROCK inhibitor is specified; cells are not single-cell seeded.

actions: Coat a 12-well plate with Matrigel
Passage hPSCs as 100 - 200 µm aggregates and count aggregates ≥ 50 µm in triplicate 5 µL samples
Plate 40 - 80 aggregates per well (10 - 20 per cm2); if working by split ratio, 1 in 40 to 1 in 200
Distribute with short back-and-forth and side-to-side motions and do not disturb for 24 h
stages.checkpoint: Day 0: 16 - 40 attached colonies per well (4 - 10 per cm2), counting even tiny colonies; do not proceed outside this range

Spin 300 x g 5 min, resuspend in SFEM II and count viable cells
stages.checkpoint: Floating cells usually appear from day 7 and increase to day 12

stages.name: Megakaryocyte maturation (Medium MK2)
stages.base_medium: Medium MK2 (StemSpan SFEM II + Supplement MK2)
stages.feeding: No medium change during the 5 days
actions: Add 1 mL Medium MK2 per well of a tissue culture-treated 12-well plate
Replate the day-12 cells at 100,000 - 350,000 cells/mL
Incubate 5 days
Day 17: wash the well by gentle pipetting, collect, spin 300 x g 5 min
stages.checkpoint: Large megakaryocytes and proplatelets by day 17; CD41a+CD42b+ purity by flow cytometry

Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent (Catalog #100-0485), ReLeSR (Catalog #100-0484) or Dispase (1 U/mL) (Catalog #07923)

kits.name: STEMdiff Blood Vessel Organoid Kit (five-stage, Wimmer-based)
kits.principle: hPSC aggregates formed in suspension are induced to mesoderm and then to vascular fate, embedded between two collagen/Matrigel layers so vessel networks sprout, and finally cut out and cultured singly in 96-well plates where they round up into organoids containing endothelial tubes covered by pericytes. Based on the Wimmer and Penninger formulation.

Dissociate with 0.5 mM EDTA (5 min) then ACCUTASE (5 min) and seed into a 6-well ultra-low adherent plate in 3 mL/well Aggregate Seeding Medium with 50 µM Y-27632, testing two densities: 2 x 10^5 and 4 x 10^5 cells/well (TeSR-E8 or mTeSR1 cultures) or 1 x 10^5 and 2 x 10^5 cells/well (mTeSR Plus cultures).

STEMdiff Blood Vessel Organoid Aggregation Supplement

kits.name: Gibco PSC Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Kit (three ready-to-use media)
kits.principle: Three complete, xeno-free media are applied one after another to a sub-confluent Essential 8 monolayer: Differentiation Medium A for two days, Differentiation Medium B for two days, then Cardiomyocyte Maintenance Medium. No factors are added by the user; the confluence at the switch to Medium A is the main variable to tune.
kits.start_requirements: Feeder-free hPSCs in Essential 8 Medium on Geltrex LDEV-free hESC-qualified matrix (recombinant vitronectin for a xeno-free set-up), 70-85% confluent on the day of splitting. Dissociate to single cells with TrypLE and seed a Geltrex-coated 12-well plate at 2 × 10^4 to 1.6 × 10^5 cells per well in Essential 8 with 1X RevitaCell Supplement, aiming for 30-70% confluence (target 35-60%) four days later. RevitaCell is only needed for the first night.

stages.name: Seed and expand hPSCs
stages.base_medium: Essential 8 Medium (not in kit)

actions: Coat a 12-well plate with Geltrex and bring it to room temperature
Rinse the hPSCs with DPBS (no Ca/Mg), detach with TrypLE for about 5-7 min at 37°C and pipette to single cells
Spin 200 × g for 4 min, resuspend in Essential 8 + 1X RevitaCell and count
Seed 2 × 10^4 to 1.6 × 10^5 cells per well; for a new line run a density series
Day 1: change to plain Essential 8; repeat on days 2 and 3

stages.name: Differentiation Medium A
stages.base_medium: Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Medium A (ready to use)
stages.feeding: Single change on day 4, 1 mL per 12-well; left for 2 days
actions: Aspirate Essential 8 and add pre-warmed Medium A
Return to 37°C, 5% CO2
stages.checkpoint: By day 6 the layer starts to look opaque; some dead cells floating is normal

stages.name: Differentiation Medium B
stages.base_medium: Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Medium B (ready to use)
stages.feeding: Single change on day 6, 1 mL per 12-well; left for 2 days
actions: Aspirate Medium A and add pre-warmed Medium B
stages.checkpoint: Culture becomes progressively more opaque by day 8; some cell shedding is normal

stages.name: Cardiomyocyte Maintenance Medium
stages.base_medium: Cardiomyocyte Maintenance Medium (ready to use)
stages.feeding: 1 mL per 12-well on day 8, then every other day (days 10 and 12 and onward)
actions: Switch to Maintenance Medium on day 8 and refeed every second day
Characterise on day 14 (the manual suggests NKX2-5 and TNNT2 immunostaining)

To replate, dissociate between 10 and 14 days after the start of differentiation with TrypLE Express (10-15 min) and reseed on Geltrex at 2 × 10^5 to 1 × 10^6 viable cells/cm² in Maintenance Medium + 1X RevitaCell
stages.checkpoint: Contractions can appear from about day 10; a contracting TNNT2-positive syncytium is expected on day 14

materials: PSC Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Kit (Differentiation Medium A 100 mL, Differentiation Medium B 100 mL, Maintenance Medium 500 mL)
Geltrex LDEV-Free hESC-Qualified Reduced Growth Factor Basement Membrane Matrix (A1413302) or recombinant vitronectin (A14700)
tips: Schedule from Thermo user guide MAN0014534 Rev. B.0; days are counted from PSC seeding (day 0), so the kit media start on day 4.
Confluence at the moment Medium A goes on drives efficiency; the guide asks for a range-finding seeding experiment for every new line.
The product page describes beating cells in as few as 8 days and cultures maintainable for more than 15 days in Maintenance Medium; the Maintenance Medium is also sold separately (A2920801).

The cryopreservation procedure in the guide is described by the vendor as not fully optimised.

kits.name: Gibco PSC Neural Induction Medium (7-day monolayer NSC induction)
kits.principle: A serum-free Neurobasal-based medium with a single 50X supplement converts adherent hPSC clumps into neural stem cells in seven days without embryoid bodies or manual rosette picking. The same supplement in a Neurobasal/Advanced DMEM/F-12 mix is then used to expand the NSCs.
kits.efficiency: Vendor product page: NSCs show >80% SOX1, SOX2 and Nestin expression with <1% OCT4; the user guide notes only about 15-50% are PAX6-positive
kits.start_requirements: High-quality feeder-free hPSCs (Essential 8 on vitronectin or Geltrex, or StemPro hESC SFM on Geltrex) at about 70-80% confluence, with differentiated colonies removed. Passage as small clumps (not single cells) onto a 6-well plate coated with the same matrix at 2.5-3 × 10^5 cells per well in 2.5 mL PSC medium, so the wells are 15-25% confluent the next day. 10 µM Y-27632 overnight at splitting is optional.

stages.name: Plate hPSC clumps
stages.base_medium: hPSC maintenance medium (e.g. Essential 8; not in kit)

factors.name: Y-27632 (10 µM, optional; not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor at splitting to limit cell death

stages.feeding: 2.5 mL per well of a 6-well plate, no change before induction
actions: Estimate the cell number of the clump suspension by dissociating an aliquot with Accutase and counting
Seed 2.5-3 × 10^5 cells per well as clumps and spread them evenly
stages.checkpoint: About 24 h later the wells should be 15-25% confluent

stages.name: Neural induction
stages.base_medium: Complete PSC Neural Induction Medium (490 mL Neurobasal Medium + 10 mL Neural Induction Supplement 50X)
stages.feeding: Change on days 2, 4 and 6; 2.5 mL per 6-well on days 0 and 2, 5 mL per well from day 4
actions: Day 0: aspirate PSC medium and add 2.5 mL pre-warmed induction medium per well
Day 2: check that colonies look uniform; mark and aspirate any non-neural colonies, then change medium
Day 4 and day 6: remove non-neural patches and feed with the doubled volume
If the layer browns with many floating cells after day 4, feed daily with 5 mL
stages.checkpoint: Near confluence by day 4, maximal confluence by day 6, dense uniform NSC sheet on day 7 with little cell death

stages.name: Harvest and expand P0 neural stem cells
stages.base_medium: Neural Expansion Medium (49 mL Neurobasal + 49 mL Advanced DMEM/F-12 + 2 mL Neural Induction Supplement per 100 mL)

factors.name: Neural Induction Supplement, 50X
factors.role: used at 1X in the expansion medium (composition proprietary)

factors.name: Y-27632 (5 µM; not in kit)
factors.role: overnight at plating for P0-P4 NSCs

stages.feeding: Replace medium the day after plating to remove Y-27632, then every other day
actions: Rinse with DPBS, detach with Accutase for 5-8 min at 37°C, scrape, pass through a 100 µm strainer
Spin 300 × g for 4 min, wash once in DPBS, resuspend in Neural Expansion Medium and count
Plate on Geltrex at 0.5-1 × 10^5 cells/cm² with 5 µM Y-27632
Passage to at least P1 before freezing (expansion medium with 10% DMSO final)
stages.checkpoint: NSCs usually reach confluence 4-6 days after plating; stain for Nestin, SOX1, SOX2, PAX6 and absence of OCT4

materials: PSC Neural Induction Medium (A1647801: 500 mL Neurobasal Medium + 10 mL Neural Induction Supplement 50X)
Advanced DMEM/F-12 (12634) for the expansion medium
Geltrex LDEV-Free hESC-qualified Reduced Growth Factor Basement Membrane Matrix (A1413301 or A1413302), used 1:100
Optional: Human Neural Stem Cell Immunocytochemistry Kit (A24354)
tips: Schedule from Thermo protocol MAN0008031 Rev. A.0; day 0 is the first day in induction medium, one day after splitting.
Complete medium keeps for 2 weeks at 2-8°C in the dark; warm it for no more than 10 minutes at 37°C.
Use plates or dishes rather than flasks so that non-neural colonies can be picked off.
For hPSCs grown in Essential 8 that lift during induction, the guide suggests coating with 10 µg/mL vitronectin.
Flat non-neural contaminants in early NSC passages can be removed by a short (3-4 min, room temperature) Accutase pre-treatment that detaches them first.
The vendor reports more than 20 million NSCs from 1 million PSCs.
pitfalls: Poor starting cultures give many non-neural colonies by day 2; if these are widespread, discard and restart.
Seeding as single cells or at too high a density causes cell death; too dense cultures brown and die from day 4.
Omitting Y-27632 when replating P0-P4 NSCs causes extensive death.
The vendor advises against expanding these NSCs in StemPro NSC SFM.
unverified: The P0 expansion stage end (day 12) is an approximation of the guide's '4-6 days after plating'.

kits.name: Gibco PSC Dopaminergic Neuron Differentiation Kit (floor plate route, ~35 days)
kits.principle: Three supplements drive a three-step floor-plate route: specification of hPSCs into midbrain floor plate progenitors, expansion of those progenitors (adherent passages, then spheres), and maturation into TH-positive midbrain dopaminergic neurons. Progenitors can be banked at passage 2.
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs maintained feeder-free in Essential 8 or Essential 8 Flex on vitronectin (VTN-N), about 70-85% confluent with differentiated colonies removed; MEF-grown lines need at least 4 passages in Essential 8 first. On day -1 seed single cells on vitronectin-coated plates (10 µg/mL coating) at 3.0-5.0 × 10^4 viable cells/cm² in Essential 8 + 10 µM Y-27632 (density given for H9; tune it so the well is fully confluent by day 7).

stages.name: Seed hPSCs
stages.base_medium: Essential 8 Medium (not in kit)

factors.name: Y-27632 (10 µM; not in kit)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor overnight for single-cell survival

stages.feeding: No change; ROCK inhibitor is removed when specification medium goes on
actions: Coat a 6-well plate (and a few wells of a 48-well plate for staining) with 10 µg/mL vitronectin for 1 h
Seed single cells at 3.0-5.0 × 10^4 viable cells/cm²
stages.checkpoint: 24 h after plating the culture should be 20-40% confluent with healthy morphology; otherwise restart or wait at most one more day in Essential 8

stages.name: Floor plate specification
stages.base_medium: Complete Floor Plate Specification Medium (95 mL Neurobasal Medium + 5 mL supplement)

factors.name: Floor Plate Specification Supplement (20X)
factors.role: specifies midbrain floor plate progenitors (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Full changes on days 3, 5, 7 and 9; normal volume (2-3 mL per 6-well) on days 3 and 5, double volume (4-5 mL) on days 7 and 9
actions: Day 0: replace Essential 8 with pre-warmed specification medium, adding and removing medium slowly
From day 7, stain a test well for FOXA2 and OTX2
Day 9: prepare Floor Plate Cell Expansion Medium
stages.checkpoint: Fully confluent by about day 7 and dense by day 10 (roughly 25-fold more cells than seeded); at least 60% FOXA2+/OTX2+ cells, otherwise repeat with a higher seeding density

stages.name: Floor plate progenitor expansion (adherent, 2 passages)
stages.base_medium: Complete Floor Plate Cell Expansion Medium (490 mL Base + 10 mL supplement)
stages.feeding: Full change the day after each passage (days 11, 13) and on day 15
actions: Day 10: lift with Accutase as clumps (no single-cell dissociation), spin 300 × g 3 min, replate 1:2 on laminin-coated plates (10 µg/mL) with 5 µM Y-27632
Day 12: dissociate the confluent layer to single cells with Accutase and replate on laminin at 2.0 × 10^5 cells/cm² with 5 µM Y-27632
Day 16: harvest passage-2 progenitors; freeze part of them at 2-5 × 10^6 cells/mL in expansion medium with 10% DMSO as a bank
stages.checkpoint: Compact, 100% confluent layers on day 12 and again on day 16; progenitors still FOXA2+/OTX2+/LMX1A+

stages.name: Sphere formation in suspension
stages.base_medium: Complete Floor Plate Cell Expansion Medium

factors.name: Floor Plate Cell Expansion Supplement (50X)
factors.role: same expansion medium, suspension culture (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Full medium change on days 17 and 19 (centrifuge 200 × g for 2 min while spheres are small, or let them settle)
actions: Resuspend fresh or thawed passage-2 progenitors at 1.0 × 10^6 viable cells/mL and transfer to non-treated low-attachment vessels (e.g. Nunclon Sphera)
Pipette gently after each feed so spheres do not fuse
Day 21: wash spheres in DPBS, dissociate with Accutase for 30 min at 37°C (swirl every 10 min), triturate to single cells and count
stages.checkpoint: Many small, uniform spheres by days 19-21 rather than one large aggregate or attached cells

stages.name: Dopaminergic neuron maturation
stages.base_medium: Complete Dopaminergic Neuron Maturation Medium (490 mL DMEM/F-12 with GlutaMAX + 10 mL supplement)

factors.name: Y-27632 (5 µM; not in kit)
factors.role: at plating; diluted out by later half changes

stages.feeding: Day 22: add an equal volume of fresh medium without ROCK inhibitor; afterwards half-volume changes every 2-3 days
actions: Coat plates with poly-D-lysine (100 µg/mL, rinse 3 times) then laminin (15 µg/mL)
Seed dissociated sphere cells at 1.0-2.0 × 10^5 cells/cm² in maturation medium + 5 µM Y-27632
For assays, replate at day 35 with TrypLE Express (30 min) into maturation medium + RevitaCell and add 0.3 µM AraC from the next day to suppress residual progenitors
stages.checkpoint: TH-positive neurons visible from about 10 days in maturation medium; 14 days recommended, with most TH+ cells co-expressing FOXA2

materials: PSC Dopaminergic Neuron Differentiation Kit (Floor Plate Specification Supplement 20X, 5 mL; Floor Plate Cell Expansion Kit: 500 mL Base + 10 mL Supplement 50X; Dopaminergic Neuron Maturation Supplement 50X, 10 mL)
Nunclon Sphera flasks or dishes for suspension culture
Optional: Human Dopaminergic Neuron Immunocytochemistry Kit (A29515)
tips: Schedule from Thermo user guide MAN0015919 Rev. 2.0; days are counted from the first day in specification medium (seeding is day -1).
Run a 48-well density series for 7 days and stain FOXA2/OTX2 before committing a new line to the full 35 days.
Supplements are heat-sensitive: no more than 1 h at 37°C, complete media used within 2 weeks at 4°C, one refreeze at most.
Each supplement is also sold separately (A3146801, A3165801, A3147401), useful when optimisation consumes extra specification medium.
Some lines differentiate without the sphere step (one extra adherent passage, plate for maturation on day 21), but the guide recommends spheres for untested lines.
Lines maintained in mTeSR1 can be started directly; the guide suggests Neurobasal base plus 1X B-27 in the maturation medium for them.
One optional extra passage (to passage 3) gives another 4-6-fold progenitor expansion; further passaging lowers FOXA2 in the resulting TH neurons.
pitfalls: Do not continue past specification if FOXA2/OTX2 double-positive cells are below 60%.
Slow-growing lines that are not confluent by day 6-7 specify poorly; raise the seeding density.
Fast aspiration or dispensing during specification strips cells; over-confluent layers can peel (Geltrex 1:100 is the suggested fallback).
Laminin coats lose function if they dry; residual poly-D-lysine is toxic, so rinse thoroughly.
Tissue-culture-treated plastic in the sphere step lets cells attach or fuse into one large sphere.
unverified: No numeric final purity (% TH+) is stated in the user guide or on the product page; efficiency left null.
The exact split ratio at the day-12 passage is given both as a fixed density (2.0 × 10^5 cells/cm²) and as roughly 1:4-6; the density is used here.

kits.name: Gibco PSC Definitive Endoderm Induction Kit (2-day, two media)
kits.principle: Two ready-to-use 1X media are applied for 24 hours each to a sparse hPSC culture on vitronectin, giving definitive endoderm in two days instead of the usual five or more.
kits.efficiency: ≥90% CXCR4+/PDGFRα− definitive endoderm cells across multiple PSC lines (vendor product page)
kits.start_requirements: Karyotypically normal, undifferentiated hPSCs grown feeder-free in Essential 8 or Essential 8 Flex on vitronectin (VTN-N), passaged routinely at about 70% surface coverage. On day 0 lift with StemPro Accutase as fine clumps and reseed on VTN-N at roughly a 1:10 split from a 70% confluent culture (1:15-1:30 if over 90% confluent; optimum 0.01-0.04 × 10^6 cells/cm²) so the culture is 15-30% confluent the next day. A ROCK inhibitor overnight is optional (1X RevitaCell, 10 µM Y-27632 or 0.5 µM thiazovivin).

stages.name: Plate hPSCs
stages.base_medium: Essential 8 Medium (not in kit)

factors.name: RevitaCell Supplement 1X, Y-27632 10 µM or thiazovivin 0.5 µM (optional; not in kit)

stages.feeding: No change; 2 mL per 6-well, 1 mL per 12-well
actions: Wash with DPBS, incubate with Accutase about 5 min at room temperature and tap the vessel to release colonies
Dilute the Accutase 1:5-1:10 with Essential 8, spin 200 × g for 5 min, flick the pellet loose
Resuspend to fine clumps with 2-3 gentle strokes and seed on VTN-N-coated plates
stages.checkpoint: 15-30% confluent on day 1; denser cultures detach during induction and should be restarted

stages.name: DE Induction Medium A
stages.base_medium: Definitive Endoderm Induction Medium A (1X complete)
stages.feeding: Single full change, left 24 h
actions: Remove Essential 8 completely and add Medium A warmed to room temperature or 37°C

stages.name: DE Induction Medium B
stages.base_medium: Definitive Endoderm Induction Medium B (1X complete)
stages.feeding: Single full change, left 24 h
actions: Remove Medium A completely and add pre-warmed Medium B
On day 3 assay the cells or move on to a downstream endoderm protocol
stages.checkpoint: Day 3: CXCR4+, SOX17+, FOXA2+ and PDGFRα-negative cells

materials: PSC Definitive Endoderm Induction Kit (Medium A 50 mL, Medium B 50 mL; stored at -20 to -5°C)
Essential 8 Medium (A15170 / A1517001) or Essential 8 Flex Medium Kit (A2858501)
tips: Schedule from Thermo user guide MAN0016100 Rev. 1.0; day 0 is plating, kit media are used on days 1 and 2.
Thaw each medium at 4°C overnight (or about 2 h at room temperature / 20 min at 37°C), mix well and use warm; thawed medium keeps 2 weeks at 2-8°C or can be aliquoted and frozen once.
The product page states that each incubation can be 24 ± 3 hours if needed.
Scrape off differentiated colonies daily before the experiment; they persist through induction.
pitfalls: Cold medium visibly disturbs the morphology of the differentiating cells.
Starting above 15-30% confluence makes the layer lift during induction.
Leaving spent medium behind at each switch reduces efficiency; aspirate completely.
unverified: The user guide's volume table lists 0.5 mM EDTA although the plating steps use Accutase; EDTA appears to be for routine passaging only.

kits.name: StemMACS CardioDiff Kit XF (8-day xeno-free monolayer)
kits.principle: One basal medium is combined with three supplements to make three phenol-red-free media that are applied in a fixed daily sequence (mesoderm induction, cultivation, cardiac induction, cultivation) to a single-cell-seeded monolayer on Matrigel, giving cardiomyocytes in 8 days.
kits.start_requirements: High-quality hPSCs at 75-85% confluence (pluripotency checked by morphology and marker staining). Dissociate to single cells with 0.05% trypsin/EDTA (5 min, stopped with soybean trypsin inhibitor), viability >95%, and seed directly into Mesoderm Induction Medium on Matrigel hESC-qualified-coated 12-well plates, 2 mL per well. For a new clone titrate 125,000, 250,000, 300,000 and 400,000 cells/cm². The data sheet does not call for a ROCK inhibitor.

stages.name: Mesoderm induction
stages.base_medium: Mesoderm Induction Medium (95 mL CardioDiff Basal Medium XF + 5 mL supplement)

factors.name: StemMACS CardioDiff Basal Medium XF
factors.role: basal medium for all three media

factors.name: StemMACS CardioDiff Mesoderm Induction Supplement XF (20X)

stages.feeding: Cells are seeded in this medium, 2 mL per 12-well, for 24 h
actions: Coat 12-well plates with Matrigel the day before and warm them to room temperature
Harvest hPSCs to single cells, count, spin 300 × g for 5 min
Resuspend in Mesoderm Induction Medium and plate

stages.name: Cardiac Cultivation Medium (first)
stages.base_medium: Cardiac Cultivation Medium (800 mL Basal Medium XF + 16 mL supplement)

factors.name: StemMACS CardioDiff Cardiac Cultivation Supplement XF (50X)
factors.role: day 1-2 and day 3 onward medium (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: One change 24 h after seeding, 2 mL per well
actions: Aspirate, wash each well with 2 mL D-PBS to remove dead cells, add Cardiac Cultivation Medium

stages.name: Cardiac induction
stages.base_medium: Cardiac Induction Medium (95 mL Basal Medium XF + 5 mL supplement)

factors.name: StemMACS CardioDiff Cardiac Induction Supplement XF (20X)

stages.feeding: One change 24 h after the previous one, 2 mL per well
actions: Aspirate, wash with 2 mL D-PBS, add Cardiac Induction Medium

stages.name: Cardiac Cultivation Medium (daily)
stages.base_medium: Cardiac Cultivation Medium

factors.name: StemMACS CardioDiff Cardiac Cultivation Supplement XF (50X)

stages.feeding: Daily full change, 2 mL per well, on days 3-8 (D-PBS wash on day 3, optional afterwards)
actions: Keep feeding daily; kit medium lasts to about day 10
Harvest from day 10 with trypsin/EDTA or, as recommended, the Multi Tissue Dissociation Kit 3
For longer culture feed StemMACS Cardiac Cultivation Medium XF (130-125-287) every two days and replate on fresh Matrigel if the sheet starts to lift
stages.checkpoint: First contractions as early as day 6 depending on the line; cardiomyocytes by day 8

materials: StemMACS CardioDiff Kit XF, human (2 × 500 mL Basal Medium XF; Mesoderm Induction Supplement 20X, 5 mL; Cardiac Cultivation Supplement 50X, 2 × 10 mL; Cardiac Induction Supplement 20X, 5 mL)
DMEM/F12 with L-glutamine, without HEPES (for Matrigel dilution)
Optional: Multi Tissue Dissociation Kit 3 (130-110-204); StemMACS Cardiac Cultivation Medium XF (130-125-287) for culture beyond day 10
tips: Schedule from the Miltenyi data sheet for order no. 130-125-289 (document 140-005-689.05).
One kit is sized for 48 wells of a 12-well plate; complete media keep up to 4 weeks at 2-8°C.
Thaw supplements overnight at 2-8°C and shake well; dissolve any white precipitate by pipetting.
The vendor states the protocol can be scaled up and that cells can be kept for 30 days or more in the cultivation medium.
pitfalls: Starting cell number is line-dependent; skipping the density titration for a new clone is the commonest cause of poor yield.
Do not mix components between kits or lots.
Dense beating sheets can detach in long cultures.
unverified: No numeric cardiomyocyte purity is stated on the product page or data sheet; efficiency left null.
The data sheet lists 0.05% trypsin/EDTA under reagents but writes 0.5% in the day-10 harvest step; confirm the concentration before harvesting.

kits.name: StemMACS Trilineage Differentiation Kit (7-day monolayer pluripotency assay)
kits.principle: A functional pluripotency test: single cells are seeded in three parallel wells and directed for seven days toward mesoderm, endoderm and ectoderm with four ready-to-use media, then scored by flow cytometry or immunostaining instead of embryoid bodies or teratomas.
kits.start_requirements: hPSCs in a PSC maintenance medium such as StemMACS iPS-Brew XF, dissociated to a single-cell suspension (0.05% trypsin/EDTA 5 min, stopped with soybean trypsin inhibitor). Seed on Matrigel hESC-qualified (1:80) in 12-well plates: 150,000 cells per well for mesoderm, 250,000 for endoderm, 200,000 for ectoderm (24-well: 80,000 / 130,000 / 100,000; equivalent to about 40,000, 66,000 and 53,000 cells/cm²). Add ROCK inhibitor (10 µM Y-27632 or 2 µM thiazovivin) for the initial plating only.

stages.name: Plate the three arms
stages.base_medium: PSC cultivation medium for the mesoderm and endoderm wells; StemMACS Trilineage EctoDiff Medium for the ectoderm well

factors.name: Y-27632 (10 µM) or thiazovivin (2 µM); not in kit
StemMACS Trilineage EctoDiff Medium
factors.role: ectoderm well is plated directly in this medium

stages.feeding: 1 mL per 12-well (0.5 mL per 24-well) at plating
actions: Aliquot the cells for each arm into separate tubes and spin 200 × g for 5 min
Resuspend each pellet in its plating medium with ROCK inhibitor and transfer to the coated plate

stages.name: Mesoderm arm: MesoDiff Medium I
stages.base_medium: StemMACS Trilineage MesoDiff Medium I
stages.feeding: Single change on day 1 with 3 mL per 12-well (1.5 mL per 24-well); no change on days 2 and 3
actions: Replace the PSC medium 24 h after plating and leave the well alone for three days

stages.name: Mesoderm arm: MesoDiff Medium II
stages.base_medium: StemMACS Trilineage MesoDiff Medium II
stages.feeding: Daily change on days 4, 5 and 6 with 2 mL per 12-well (1 mL per 24-well)
actions: Analyse on day 7
stages.checkpoint: Day 7: CD144+ endothelial cells and/or CD140b+ (or SM22α+) smooth-muscle cells; their ratio varies by line

stages.name: Endoderm arm: EndoDiff Medium
stages.base_medium: StemMACS Trilineage EndoDiff Medium
stages.feeding: No change on day 1 (cells stay in PSC medium for 2 days); from day 2 to day 6 wash daily with 2 mL D-PBS containing Ca/Mg, then add 1 mL per 12-well (0.5 mL per 24-well)
actions: Analyse on day 7
stages.checkpoint: Day 7: CD184 (CXCR4)+ SOX17+ definitive endoderm; FOXA2 as an additional marker

stages.name: Ectoderm arm: EctoDiff Medium
stages.base_medium: StemMACS Trilineage EctoDiff Medium
stages.feeding: Daily change on days 1-6 with 1 mL per 12-well (0.5 mL per 24-well)
actions: Analyse on day 7
stages.checkpoint: Day 7: PAX6+ SOX2+ neuroectoderm

materials: StemMACS Trilineage Differentiation Kit, human (MesoDiff Medium I 36 mL, MesoDiff Medium II 72 mL, EndoDiff Medium 60 mL, EctoDiff Medium 84 mL; for 12 assays)
PSC cultivation medium, e.g. StemMACS iPS-Brew XF (130-104-368)
ROCK inhibitor: StemMACS Y27632 (130-103-922) or StemMACS Thiazovivin (130-104-461)
Corning Matrigel hESC-qualified Matrix and DMEM/F12 (no HEPES) for dilution
Antibodies for readout (e.g. CD144, CD140b, CD184, SOX17, PAX6, SOX2)
tips: Schedule from the Miltenyi data sheet for order no. 130-115-660 (document 140-005-218.03).
12-well format suits flow cytometry; 24-well is enough for immunostaining.
Media arrive frozen: thaw at 2-8°C overnight, then use within 2 weeks; aliquots can be kept at -20°C.
Several lines can be tested in parallel; seeding numbers may need adjusting per line.
For flow cytometry, harvest as for hPSCs with half the volumes.
pitfalls: Clumps instead of a true single-cell suspension invalidate the seeding numbers; the data sheet treats single cells as mandatory.
ROCK inhibitor is for the initial plating only.
Changing the mesoderm well on days 2 or 3 departs from the protocol.
unverified: The kit is a qualitative/quantitative assay; no expected percentage of marker-positive cells is given, so efficiency is null.

kits.name: StemMACS EndothelDiff Kit XF (7-day xeno-free monolayer)
kits.principle: Single-cell-seeded hPSCs are taken through two differentiation media made from one basal medium and two supplements (three days without a change, then three daily feeds), yielding endothelial cells in seven days that can be enriched with CD144 MicroBeads and expanded in the kit's cultivation medium.
kits.start_requirements: High-quality hPSCs in StemMACS iPS-Brew XF or PSC-Brew XF at 75-85% confluence. Dissociate to single cells (0.05% trypsin/EDTA or TrypLE, 5 min, stopped with soybean trypsin inhibitor; viability >95%) and seed about 150,000 cells per well of a 12-well plate coated the day before with MACSmatrix Laminin 511 (0.35 µg/cm²) or Matrigel, in 1 mL iPS-Brew/PSC-Brew with ROCK inhibitor (e.g. 2 µM thiazovivin). Titrate the cell number for each new clone.

stages.name: Plate hPSCs
stages.base_medium: StemMACS iPS-Brew XF or PSC-Brew XF complete medium (not in kit)

factors.name: StemMACS Thiazovivin (e.g. 2 µM) or other ROCK inhibitor; not in kit

stages.feeding: 1 mL per 12-well for 24 h
actions: Coat plates on day -1 and warm them before use
Harvest single cells, spin 300 × g for 5 min, resuspend with ROCK inhibitor and plate

stages.name: EndothelDiff Medium I
stages.base_medium: EndothelDiff Medium I (170 mL StemMACS PSC-Brew Basal Medium XF + 3.4 mL supplement)

factors.name: StemMACS PSC-Brew Basal Medium XF
factors.role: basal medium supplied in the kit

stages.feeding: Single change on day 1 with 3 mL per 12-well; no further change for three days
actions: Aspirate the PSC medium 24 h after seeding and add EndothelDiff Medium I

stages.name: EndothelDiff Medium II
stages.base_medium: EndothelDiff Medium II (330 mL StemMACS PSC-Brew Basal Medium XF + 6.6 mL supplement)
stages.feeding: 2 mL per 12-well on day 4, then fresh medium every 24 h on days 5 and 6
actions: Day 6: coat plates for the cultivation step (Laminin-411-E8 fragment or collagen I)
Day 7: wash with D-PBS, detach with Accutase for 5 min at 37°C, dilute with D-PBS, spin 300 × g for 5 min and resuspend in Endothel Cultivation Medium
Optionally enrich with CD144 (VE-Cadherin) MicroBeads, advised especially when fewer than 50% of cells are endothelial
stages.checkpoint: Day 7: check CD144, CD34, CD105, CD309 (VEGFR-2) and CD140b by flow cytometry

stages.name: Endothelial cell cultivation
stages.base_medium: Endothel Cultivation Medium (125 mL StemMACS Endothel Cultivation Basal Medium XF + 5 mL supplement)

factors.name: StemMACS Endothel Cultivation Basal Medium XF

stages.feeding: Full change after 3-4 days, 2 mL per 6-well
actions: Seed 10,000-20,000 cells/cm² on Laminin-411-E8 or collagen I-coated 6-well plates
Harvest with TrypLE once the wells are fully confluent
stages.checkpoint: Confluent within about 7 days; cells suitable for flow cytometry, lipid-uptake or tube-formation assays

materials: StemMACS EndothelDiff Kit XF, human (PSC-Brew Basal Medium XF 500 mL; EndothelDiff Supplement I 50X, 4 mL; EndothelDiff Supplement II 50X, 7 mL; Endothel Cultivation Basal Medium XF 125 mL; Endothel Cultivation Supplement 25X, 5 mL)
StemMACS iPS-Brew XF (130-104-368) or StemMACS PSC-Brew XF (130-127-865)
MACSmatrix Laminin 511 (130-136-454) or Corning Matrigel hESC-qualified Matrix for differentiation
Laminin-411-E8 fragment or collagen I for cultivation
0.05% Trypsin/EDTA or TrypLE, soybean trypsin inhibitor (0.5 mg/mL), Accutase, D-PBS without Ca/Mg
Optional: CD144 (VE-Cadherin) MicroBeads, human (130-097-857); StemMACS Endothel Cultivation Medium XF (130-139-193) for further expansion
tips: Schedule from the Miltenyi data sheet for order no. 130-139-194 (document 140-007-412.01).
One kit is sized for 55 wells of a 12-well plate.
Use EndothelDiff Media I and II within 2 weeks and the cultivation medium within 3 weeks of preparation (2-8°C).
The vendor states the derived cells can be cultivated for more than 14 days in Endothel Cultivation Medium.
pitfalls: Seeding number is clone-dependent; titrate before a large run.
Without CD144 enrichment, low-purity differentiations expand poorly as endothelial cultures.
Do not mix components between kits or lots.
unverified: No numeric endothelial purity is stated on the product page or data sheet; efficiency left null.
The cultivation stage end (day 14) reflects the data sheet's 'confluent within 7 days' after replating.

kits.name: StemMACS Cerebral OrganoidDiff Kit XF (matrix-free, 30 days)
kits.principle: Four media made from two basal media and four supplements take single hPSCs through aggregate formation in ultra-low-attachment 96-well plates, two neural induction steps and a shaking cultivation step, without any embedding in extracellular matrix.

kits.name: Quick-Neuron Excitatory - SeV Kit
kits.principle: A temperature-sensitive Sendai virus delivers a proprietary transcription-factor set to hPSCs in suspension; the virus replicates at 33 C, is switched off by shifting to 37 C on day 2, and puromycin selection removes untransduced cells, giving footprint-free glutamatergic neurons in 10 days.
kits.efficiency: The release specification for the matching ready-made cell product (EX-SeV-HC-CW50065) is over 80% TUBB3+ and over 50% VGLUT1+/TUBB3+ at day 7 post-differentiation; no separate figure is published for user runs with the kit
kits.start_requirements: Source hPSCs must have been maintained by single-cell passaging (StemFit Basic04, StemFit AK02N or StemFlex) and be at least 14 days post-thaw. Wells of a 6-well plate are precoated on day -3 with iMatrix-511 silk at 0.25 ug/cm2 in 2 mL chilled PBS and held at 4 C (or coated on day 0 and warmed 2 h at 37 C). Starting cultures must be 50-70% confluent and never above 90%. ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 is used at 10 uM stock diluted 1:1000 (final 10 uM) in the pre-harvest and plating media. A puromycin kill curve must be run in advance; the vendor's internal range is 0.5-2 ug/mL. This kit needs about 3.3 x 10^6 viable hPSCs, usually 3 wells of a 6-well plate at 50-70% confluency, and a stable 33 C, 5% CO2 incubator. One kit covers 6 wells of a 6-well plate.

stages.base_medium: Chilled PBS with iMatrix-511 silk

factors.name: iMatrix-511 silk (user-supplied)
factors.role: laminin-511 E8 fragment coating at 0.25 ug/cm2

stages.name: Day 0: Sendai virus treatment and plating

factors.name: QN-SeV-P (Sendai virus particles)

factors.name: Y-27632 (user-supplied)

stages.feeding: Single plating; 1 mL Medium iN per well at 0.5 x 10^6 cells per well of a 6-well plate
actions: Pre-treat the hPSC wells 1 h at 37 C with maintenance medium plus Y-27632
Lift with 300 uL Solution D1 (0.5X TrypLE Select with EDTA) for about 5 min at 37 C and collect in Medium iN
Count, take 3.3 x 10^6 cells plus 10% and bring the volume to 580 uL with Medium iN
Add the whole QN-SeV-P vial, mix by finger-tapping only (never vortex or pipette the virus) and incubate 10 min at 33 C with tapping every 2 min
Bring the suspension to 6.6 mL, plate 1 mL per coated well and incubate overnight at 33 C

stages.name: Day 1: Medium N(G1) with puromycin
stages.base_medium: Medium N(G1) (Medium N with Component G1)

factors.name: Puromycin (user-supplied)
factors.role: selection against untransduced cells at the kill-curve concentration, 0.5-2 ug/mL

stages.feeding: 1.5 mL per well, overnight at 33 C
actions: Make Medium N(G1) (40 uL Component G1 per 20 mL Medium N)
Add puromycin at the pre-determined concentration

stages.name: Day 2: second selection and shift to 37 C
stages.base_medium: Medium N(G1) with puromycin
stages.feeding: 1.5 mL per well in the late afternoon, then overnight at 37 C
actions: Change to fresh Medium N(G1) with puromycin late in the day
Move the plate to 37 C, which inactivates the Sendai virus
If more than 90% of cells survive puromycin, raise the concentration
stages.checkpoint: Untransduced control wells should be dead by about 60 h of puromycin

stages.name: Day 3: passage onto ornithine/laminin in Medium N(G2P)
stages.base_medium: Medium iN(G2P) (Medium N with Components G2 and P plus 10 uM Y-27632)

factors.name: Component P
factors.role: supplement added from the day-3 passage onward (composition proprietary)

factors.name: Y-27632 (user-supplied)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor for the replating step

stages.feeding: Replate at 5 x 10^5 cells per well (6-well), 1 x 10^5 (24-well) or 1.5 x 10^4 (96-well); total 1 mL, 300 uL or 50 uL per well

stages.name: Day 4: first full medium change
stages.base_medium: Medium N(G2P)
stages.feeding: 3 mL per well (6-well), 800 uL (24-well) or 150 uL (96-well), then 3 days undisturbed at 37 C

stages.name: Day 7: half medium change

stages.feeding: Replace half the volume (1.5 mL per 6-well, 400 uL per 24-well, 75 uL per 96-well) and leave 3 more days

kits.name: Quick-Neuron GABAergic - mRNA Kit
kits.principle: Instead of a virus, synthetic transcription-factor mRNAs are lipofected into an hPSC monolayer four times over two days; puromycin selects the transfected cells, the culture is passaged on day 3 onto ornithine/laminin, and GAD1/parvalbumin-positive GABAergic neurons are ready by day 10.
kits.efficiency: The release specification for the matching ready-made cell product (GA-mRNA-HC-CW50065) is over 80% TUBB3+, over 50% GAD65/67+/TUBB3+ and over 50% PVALB+/TUBB3+ at day 7; no separate figure is published for user runs with the kit
kits.start_requirements: Source hPSCs must have been maintained by single-cell passaging (StemFit Basic04, StemFit AK02N or StemFlex) and be at least 14 days post-thaw. Wells of a 6-well plate are precoated on day -3 with iMatrix-511 silk at 0.25 ug/cm2 in 2 mL chilled PBS and held at 4 C (or coated on day 0 and warmed 2 h at 37 C). Starting cultures must be 50-70% confluent and never above 90%. ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 is used at 10 uM stock diluted 1:1000 (final 10 uM) in the pre-harvest and plating media. A puromycin kill curve must be run in advance; the vendor's internal range is 0.5-2 ug/mL. About 3.6 x 10^6 viable hPSCs are needed (2-3 wells of a 6-well plate at 50-70% confluency); no 33 C incubator is required because this kit uses mRNA rather than Sendai virus. Transfection uses Lipofectamine MessengerMAX; an alternative reagent must give at least 80% transfection efficiency. One kit covers 6 wells of a 6-well plate.

stages.feeding: Replate at 5 x 10^5 (6-well), 1 x 10^5 (24-well) or 1.5 x 10^4 (96-well) cells per well; totals 1 mL, 300 uL, 50 uL
actions: Coat the new plate with 0.002% poly-L-ornithine (2 h, 37 C), wash twice with PBS and coat with diluted laminin (2 h, 37 C)
Lift with 300 uL Solution D1 for 3 min at 37 C and collect in 750 uL Medium N(G1P) with 6-8 gentle strokes
Accept the 10-20% of cells that stay down
Count, prepare 1 x 10^6 viable cells/mL and add to wells preloaded with Medium N(G1P)

stages.name: Day 4: switch to Medium N(G2P)
stages.base_medium: Medium N(G2P) (Medium N(P) with Component G2)
stages.feeding: 2 mL per 6-well, 800 uL per 24-well or 150 uL per 96-well, then 2 days at 37 C
actions: Make Medium N(G2P) and change the medium, rinsing gently with PBS first if there is floating debris
Incubate 2 days
stages.checkpoint: Differentiated neurons visible from about day 5

stages.name: Day 7: full medium change
stages.base_medium: Medium N(G2P)
stages.feeding: 4 mL per 6-well, 1 mL per 24-well or 250 uL per 96-well
actions: Exchange the medium, with an optional gentle PBS rinse

stages.name: Day 9: half medium change, day 10 assay
stages.base_medium: Medium N(G2P), then Quick-Neuron GABAergic Maintenance Medium (GA-MM)

factors.name: Quick-Neuron GABAergic Maintenance Medium (GA-MM, sold separately)

stages.feeding: Replace half the volume on day 9 (1.5 mL per 6-well, 400 uL per 24-well, 75 uL per 96-well); switch to maintenance medium from day 10
actions: Half-change the medium on day 9
On day 10 assay the neurons or continue in GA-MM
Confirm identity with TUBB3, GAD1 and parvalbumin
stages.checkpoint: TUBB3-positive neurons co-expressing GAD1/parvalbumin

materials: Quick-Neuron GABAergic - mRNA Kit (GA-mRNA): QNG-mRNA-P (4 vials), Component N, Component G1, Component G2, Component P
0.01% poly-L-ornithine (Sigma P4957) and laminin mouse protein natural (Thermo 23017015) or Geltrex (A15696-01) for the replating plate
StemFit Basic04 Complete Type (AMSBio SF041-001), StemFit AK02N or StemFlex (Thermo A3349401)

ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 (Selleckchem S1049) and DMSO (Sigma D2650)

Plating two wells at each of three densities on day 0 is deliberate - it hedges against the confluency window
Tap the mRNA tube to mix; do not vortex

Day 1 and day 2 are roughly 8 h bench days each
If the day-2 cultures are under 50% confluent with heavy death, the guide says to skip the last two transfections rather than push on

kits.name: Quick-Neuron Sensory - mRNA Kit
kits.principle: Four lipofections of synthetic transcription-factor mRNA over two days, with puromycin selection and a sensory patterning supplement (S1) in the neural medium from day 1, give peripherin/BRN3A/SCN9A-positive sensory neurons by day 10; the passage onto ornithine/laminin falls on day 4 in this kit.
kits.efficiency: The release specification for the matching ready-made cell product is over 80% TUBB3+, over 50% PRPH+ and over 50% SCN9A+/TUBB3+ at day 7 (ISL1 stained without a threshold); no separate figure is published for user runs with the kit
kits.start_requirements: Source hPSCs must have been maintained by single-cell passaging (StemFit Basic04, StemFit AK02N or StemFlex) and be at least 14 days post-thaw. Wells of a 6-well plate are precoated on day -3 with iMatrix-511 silk at 0.25 ug/cm2 in 2 mL chilled PBS and held at 4 C (or coated on day 0 and warmed 2 h at 37 C). Starting cultures must be 50-70% confluent and never above 90%. ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 is used at 10 uM stock diluted 1:1000 (final 10 uM) in the pre-harvest and plating media. A puromycin kill curve must be run in advance; the vendor's internal range is 0.5-2 ug/mL. About 4.6 x 10^6 viable hPSCs are needed; cells are plated at three densities (0.6, 0.7 and 0.8 x 10^6 per well of a 6-well plate), two wells each. No 33 C incubator is needed. Transfection uses Lipofectamine MessengerMAX (an alternative must reach at least 80% efficiency). The guide for this full-size kit assumes the user has already run the small-size kit (SS-mRNA-S) and optimised conditions for their line.

stages.name: Day -3: plate preparation
stages.base_medium: Chilled PBS with iMatrix-511 silk
stages.feeding: None; hold at 4 C
actions: Coat a 6-well plate with diluted iMatrix-511 silk and keep at 4 C
Prepare Medium N(S1) from Components N and S1 with DMEM/F12, Neurobasal, GlutaMAX and penicillin-streptomycin; keep dark at 4 C for up to 2 weeks

stages.name: Day 0: plating at three densities
stages.base_medium: Medium iS (hPSC maintenance medium with 10 uM Y-27632)

factors.name: Y-27632 (user-supplied)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor in the plating medium

stages.feeding: 1 mL per well; two wells each at 0.6, 0.7 and 0.8 x 10^6 cells
actions: Pre-treat the source wells 1 h at 37 C in Medium iS
Harvest with Solution D1, count and set up the three density tubes
Plate 1 mL per coated well and incubate overnight at 37 C
stages.checkpoint: All six wells at 50-70% confluency before transfection

stages.name: Day 1: first and second mRNA transfections, then selection
stages.base_medium: Medium S during transfection; Medium N(S1) with puromycin overnight
stages.feeding: 1.25 mL transfection mix per well for 2.5 h, 1 mL Medium S for 2 h, a second 2.5 h transfection, then 1.5 mL Medium N(S1) with puromycin overnight
actions: Prepare Mix 1 (Opti-MEM + MessengerMAX, 10 min) and Mix 2 (Opti-MEM + one QNS-mRNA-P vial, tapped)
Combine to make QNS, hold 5 min, add 6.6 mL Medium S and apply 1.25 mL per well
After the second transfection switch to Medium N(S1) with puromycin

stages.name: Day 2: third and fourth transfections in Medium N(S1)
stages.base_medium: Medium N(S1), with puromycin overnight
stages.feeding: Two further 2.5 h transfections (this time made up in Medium N(S1)) separated by a 2 h rest, then 1.5 mL Medium N(S1) with puromycin
actions: Check the cultures are reaching 90% confluency; if they are below 50% with heavy death, skip to day 3 and run a day early
Repeat the transfection twice, using Medium N(S1) in place of Medium S
Finish in Medium N(S1) with puromycin
stages.checkpoint: Cultures at or approaching 90% confluency

stages.name: Day 3: medium change with selection
stages.base_medium: Medium N(S1) with puromycin
stages.feeding: 1.5 mL per well, added very slowly down the well wall, leaving a film of old medium behind
actions: Change the medium gently, leaving just enough old medium to keep the surface wet

stages.name: Day 4: passage onto ornithine/laminin in Medium N(S1P)
stages.base_medium: Medium N(S1P) (Medium N(S1) with Component P)

factors.name: Component P
factors.role: supplement added at the passage (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: Replate at 5 x 10^5 (6-well), 1 x 10^5 (24-well) or 1.5 x 10^4 (96-well) cells per well; totals 1 mL, 300 uL, 50 uL
actions: Coat the new plate with 0.002% poly-L-ornithine (2 h, 37 C), wash twice with PBS, then laminin (2 h, 37 C)
Lift with 300 uL Solution D1 for 3 min at 37 C, add 750 uL Medium N(S1P) and detach by tapping each long side of the plate 5 times rather than pipetting
Count and add a 1 x 10^6 viable cells/mL suspension to wells preloaded with Medium N(S1P)

stages.name: Day 5: medium change
stages.base_medium: Medium N(S1P)
stages.feeding: 2 mL per 6-well, 800 uL per 24-well or 150 uL per 96-well
actions: Exchange the medium, optionally after a gentle 1 mL PBS rinse down the wall

stages.name: Days 7-9: half medium changes every 2 days
stages.base_medium: Medium N(S1P)
stages.feeding: Replace half the volume (1 mL per 6-well, 400 uL per 24-well, 75 uL per 96-well) every 2 days
actions: Half-change the medium every other day up to day 10

stages.name: Day 10: assay or continued maturation
stages.base_medium: Quick-Neuron Sensory Maintenance Medium (SS-MM) or user's choice

factors.name: Quick-Neuron Sensory Maintenance Medium (SS-MM, sold separately)

stages.feeding: Switch to maintenance medium from day 10
actions: Assay the neurons or continue in SS-MM
Confirm identity with SCN9A, peripherin, ISL1 and BRN3A; the guide gives qPCR primers for these normalised to PGK1 and compares against human dorsal root ganglion RNA
stages.checkpoint: Neurite networks positive for peripherin, BRN3A, ISL1 and SCN9A

materials: Quick-Neuron Sensory - mRNA Kit (SS-mRNA): QNS-mRNA-P (4 vials), Component N, Component S1, Component P
0.01% poly-L-ornithine (Sigma P4957) and laminin mouse protein natural (Thermo 23017015) or Geltrex (A15696-01) for the replating plate
StemFit Basic04 Complete Type (AMSBio SF041-001), StemFit AK02N or StemFlex (Thermo A3349401)
TrypLE Select Enzyme 1X (Thermo 12563011) and 0.02% EDTA in DPBS (Sigma E8008) for Solution D1
ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 (Selleckchem S1049) and DMSO (Sigma D2650)
Optional STEM-CELLBANKER (AMSBIO 11890) for cryopreserving at the day-3 passage
tips: Unlike the other Quick kits, the passage here is on day 4, and the cells are freed by tapping the plate rather than pipetting
A smaller SS-mRNA-S kit exists for first-time optimisation on a new line
Medium changes from day 3 on should be slow and down the well wall; these cultures lift easily
pitfalls: Two long transfection days back to back
Starting confluency outside 50-70% at the time of transfection disqualifies a well
Sensory cultures are among the most fragile to feed; losing the monolayer at day 3-5 is the common failure
unverified: No purity figure published for user differentiations with the kit itself
The guide text in one transfection step refers to a 'QNG1-mRNA' vial, apparently a copy-over from the GABAergic guide

kits.name: Quick-Muscle Skeletal - SeV Kit
kits.principle: Sendai virus carrying myogenic transcription factors is dropped straight onto freshly plated hPSCs at 33 C, boosted the next day by a transfected mesendoderm mRNA, then selected with puromycin and shifted to 37 C, giving myosin-heavy-chain-positive skeletal muscle cells in 7 days.
kits.efficiency: The release specification for the matching ready-made cell product (CW50065) is over 70% MHC-positive cells at day 7 post-differentiation; no separate figure is published for user runs with the kit
kits.start_requirements: Source hPSCs must have been maintained by single-cell passaging (StemFit Basic04, StemFit AK02N or StemFlex) and be at least 14 days post-thaw. Wells of a 6-well plate are precoated on day -3 with iMatrix-511 silk at 0.25 ug/cm2 in 2 mL chilled PBS and held at 4 C (or coated on day 0 and warmed 2 h at 37 C). Starting cultures must be 50-70% confluent and never above 90%. ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 is used at 10 uM stock diluted 1:1000 (final 10 uM) in the pre-harvest and plating media. A puromycin kill curve must be run in advance; the vendor's internal range is 0.5-2 ug/mL. About 4 x 10^6 viable hPSCs are needed (3 wells of a 6-well plate at 50-70% confluency) and a stable 33 C, 5% CO2 incubator. Cells are plated across six wells at a range of densities (the virus dose is scaled per well from 4 x 10^5 to 9 x 10^5 cells) in Medium M, a KnockOut Serum Replacement-based MEM-alpha medium made up by the user. One kit covers 6 wells of a 6-well plate.

stages.name: Day -3: plate preparation
stages.base_medium: Chilled PBS with iMatrix-511 silk
stages.feeding: None; hold the plate at 4 C
actions: Dilute 43.2 uL iMatrix-511 silk in 13 mL chilled PBS and add 2 mL per well of 6 wells

Prepare Medium M (MEM-alpha without nucleosides, 5% KnockOut Serum Replacement, sodium pyruvate, non-essential amino acids, GlutaMAX, penicillin-streptomycin, 0.1 mM beta-mercaptoethanol) and Medium M(P)

stages.name: Day 0: plate, then add Sendai virus per well
stages.base_medium: Medium iM (Medium M with 10 uM Y-27632)

factors.name: QMS-SeV (Sendai virus particles)
factors.role: myogenic transcription factors; dose scaled to the cells plated per well (for example 7.8 uL for 5 x 10^5 cells)

factors.name: Y-27632 (user-supplied)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor for harvest and plating

stages.feeding: 1 mL Medium iM per well; densities spread from 4 x 10^5 to 9 x 10^5 cells per well
actions: Pre-treat the source hPSCs 1 h at 37 C in maintenance medium with Y-27632
Harvest with 300 uL Solution D1 per well and resuspend in Medium iM
Plate 1 mL per coated well at the chosen densities and rock to distribute evenly
Add the per-well QMS-SeV volume as small drops touching the medium surface at several points; never vortex or pipette the virus
Incubate overnight at 33 C

stages.name: Day 1: medium change, mesendoderm mRNA boost, medium change
stages.base_medium: Medium M; the boost is delivered in Medium M

factors.name: Mesendoderm RNA-P (synthetic mRNA)
factors.role: mesendoderm booster transfected once on day 1 (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: 1 mL Medium M, 1-4 h at 33 C depending on confluency; then 1.2 mL booster mix per well for 2.5 h; then 2 mL Medium M overnight at 33 C
actions: Change to 1 mL Medium M and incubate 1-4 h: immediately to 1 h if wells are 50-70% confluent, up to 4 h if under 50%, within 1 h if over 70%
Make Mix 1 (800 uL Opti-MEM + 33 uL MessengerMAX, 10 min) and Mix 2 (800 uL Opti-MEM + 36 uL Mesendoderm RNA-P, tapped not vortexed)
Combine, hold 5 min, add 6 mL Medium M and apply 1.2 mL per well for 2.5 h at 33 C
Replace with 2 mL Medium M and keep at 33 C overnight
stages.checkpoint: Confluency decides the pre-boost incubation; over 70% confluent wells are expected to differentiate less well

stages.name: Day 2: puromycin selection
stages.base_medium: Medium M with puromycin

factors.name: Puromycin (user-supplied)
factors.role: selection at the kill-curve concentration, 0.5-2 ug/mL

stages.feeding: 2 mL per well, overnight at 33 C
actions: Replace most of the medium with Medium M plus puromycin and keep at 33 C
stages.checkpoint: Untransduced puromycin control should be dying out by about 60 h

stages.name: Day 3: medium change and shift to 37 C
stages.base_medium: Medium M

factors.name: Medium M (user-made KSR-based medium)
factors.role: carrier medium during the temperature shift

stages.feeding: 2 mL per well, late in the day, then overnight at 37 C
actions: Change to fresh Medium M in the late afternoon
Move the plate to 37 C, which inactivates the Sendai virus

stages.name: Day 4: Medium M(P) maintenance
stages.base_medium: Medium M(P) (Medium M with Component P)
stages.feeding: 2 mL per well, then 3 days at 37 C
actions: Change to Medium M(P) and leave the cultures undisturbed for 3 days
stages.checkpoint: Elongated spindle-shaped muscle cells are visible from day 4

stages.name: Day 7: assay or continued maturation
stages.base_medium: Quick-Muscle Skeletal Maintenance Medium (SM-MM) or user's choice

factors.name: Quick-Muscle Skeletal Maintenance Medium (SM-MM, sold separately)

stages.feeding: Switch to maintenance medium from day 7
actions: Assay or carry the culture on in SM-MM
Confirm with an anti-myosin heavy chain antibody
stages.checkpoint: Elongated MHC-positive muscle cells by day 7

materials: Quick-Muscle Skeletal - SeV Kit (SM-SeV): QMS-SeV, Mesendoderm RNA-P, Component P

MEM-alpha without nucleosides (Thermo 12561056), KnockOut Serum Replacement (10828010), sodium pyruvate (11360070), MEM non-essential amino acids (11140050), beta-mercaptoethanol (21985023), GlutaMAX (35050061), penicillin-streptomycin (15140122)
StemFit Basic04 Complete Type (AMSBio SF041-001), StemFit AK02N or StemFlex (Thermo A3349401)
TrypLE Select Enzyme 1X (Thermo 12563011) and 0.02% EDTA in DPBS (Sigma E8008) for Solution D1
ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 (Selleckchem S1049) and DMSO (Sigma D2650)
Optional STEM-CELLBANKER (AMSBIO 11890) for cryopreserving at the day-3 passage
tips: The virus is added to the well after plating, as surface drops, not pre-incubated with the cells as in the Quick-Neuron kits
Plating a spread of densities on day 0 lets you pick the best well, since the virus dose is tabulated per density
The day-1 incubation length is set by what you see down the microscope, not by the clock
pitfalls: BSL-2 containment is required for the Sendai virus
Wells over 70% confluent at the day-1 boost give lower differentiation efficiency
Medium M is made by the user from seven components; a mistake there affects the whole run
unverified: No purity figure published for user differentiations with the kit itself
No fusion index or myotube-formation metric is given; the guide only shows MHC staining at day 7

kits.name: Quick-Glia Astrocyte - SeV Kit
kits.principle: Sendai virus delivering astrocytic transcription factors at 33 C, followed by a 37 C shift on day 2 and a switch into a commercial astrocyte medium on day 4, carries hPSCs to CD44/S100B/ALDH1L1-positive astrocytes by day 28, with GFAP rising further by day 42.
kits.start_requirements: Source hPSCs must have been maintained by single-cell passaging (StemFit Basic04, StemFit AK02N or StemFlex) and be at least 14 days post-thaw. Wells of a 6-well plate are precoated on day -3 with iMatrix-511 silk at 0.25 ug/cm2 in 2 mL chilled PBS and held at 4 C (or coated on day 0 and warmed 2 h at 37 C). Starting cultures must be 50-70% confluent and never above 90%. ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 is used at 10 uM stock diluted 1:1000 (final 10 uM) in the pre-harvest and plating media. A puromycin kill curve must be run in advance; the vendor's internal range is 0.5-2 ug/mL. This kit needs about 2 x 10^6 viable hPSCs (2 wells of a 6-well plate at 50-70% confluency), a stable 33 C, 5% CO2 incubator, and a ScienCell Astrocyte Medium Kit (ScienCell 1801) plus Geltrex for the day-17 passage. No puromycin selection step is used. One kit covers 6 wells of a 6-well plate.

stages.name: Day -3: plate preparation
stages.base_medium: Chilled PBS with iMatrix-511 silk
stages.feeding: None; hold the plate at 4 C
actions: Dilute 44.6 uL iMatrix-511 silk in 13.5 mL chilled PBS and add 2 mL per well
Prepare Medium N1 from Component N1 with DMEM/F12, Neurobasal, GlutaMAX and penicillin-streptomycin

stages.name: Day 0: Sendai virus treatment and plating
stages.base_medium: Medium iN1 (Medium N1 with 10 uM Y-27632)

factors.name: QGA-SeV (undiluted Sendai virus)
factors.role: delivers the astrocytic transcription factors; active at 33 C

factors.name: Y-27632 (user-supplied)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor for harvest and plating

stages.feeding: Plate 0.3 x 10^6 cells in 1 mL Medium iN1 per well of a 6-well plate
actions: Pre-treat the source wells 1 h at 37 C in maintenance medium with Y-27632
Harvest with 300 uL Solution D1 per well and collect in Medium iN1
Bring 1.98 x 10^6 cells to 340 uL, add the whole QGA-SeV vial, tap to mix and hold 10 min at 33 C with tapping every 2 min
Make up to 6.6 mL, plate 1 mL per well and incubate overnight at 33 C

stages.name: Day 1: switch to Medium A1
stages.base_medium: Medium A1 (Medium N1 with Components GA1 and GA2)
stages.feeding: 1.5 mL per well, overnight at 33 C
actions: Make Medium A1 (60 uL each of Components GA1 and GA2 per 30 mL Medium N1)
Change the medium, leaving a little behind so the cells never dry, and keep at 33 C

stages.name: Day 2: medium change and shift to 37 C
stages.base_medium: Medium A1
stages.feeding: 1.5 mL per well late in the day, then overnight at 37 C
actions: Change to fresh Medium A1 in the late afternoon
Move the plate to 37 C to inactivate the virus

stages.name: Day 3: ride out the cell death
stages.base_medium: Medium A1
stages.feeding: 1.5 mL per well overnight; a gentle PBS rinse is recommended if there is a lot of floating debris
actions: Expect visible cell death the day after the temperature shift and compare with the recovery images in the guide
Change the medium gently, down the well wall
stages.checkpoint: Cell death peaks here; the culture should be on a recovery trajectory afterwards

stages.name: Day 4: switch to ScienCell astrocyte medium with 2% FBS
stages.base_medium: ScienCell Astrocyte Medium: basal medium with astrocyte growth supplement, penicillin-streptomycin and 2% FBS

factors.name: ScienCell Astrocyte Medium Kit (user-supplied, ScienCell 1801)
factors.role: serum-containing astrocyte growth medium from day 4

stages.feeding: 2.5 mL per well added slowly down the wall, then 3 days at 37 C
actions: Make up ScienCell medium with 2% FBS
Replace the medium, leaving a film behind, and incubate 3 days

stages.name: Days 7-16: maintenance in 2% FBS astrocyte medium
stages.base_medium: ScienCell Astrocyte Medium with 2% FBS
stages.feeding: Half change (1.25 mL of 2.5 mL) every 2-3 days
actions: Replace half the medium every 2-3 days, adding it slowly along the well wall
stages.checkpoint: Flat, spreading glial morphology developing over the second week

stages.name: Day 17: passage onto Geltrex into FBS-free medium
stages.base_medium: ScienCell Astrocyte Medium without FBS
stages.feeding: Replate at 2.5 x 10^5 cells per well (6-well), 5 x 10^4 (24-well) or 8 x 10^3 (96-well) from a 0.5 x 10^6 cells/mL suspension; totals 1.5 mL, 500 uL, 50 uL
actions: Coat the new plate with Geltrex (at least 1 h at 37 C, or 4 C overnight) and preload with FBS-free ScienCell medium
Lift with 300 uL Solution D1 for 5-10 min at 37 C and collect in 1 mL FBS-free medium with 6-8 gentle strokes
Accept the 10-20% of cells that stay attached
Count, plate at the recommended density, rock to distribute and let the cells settle 10 min at room temperature before the incubator
Surplus cells can be frozen at 1-4 x 10^6 per vial in STEM-CELLBANKER
stages.checkpoint: The recommended density should give a confluent culture in about two weeks; growth rate is line-dependent

stages.name: Day 18 to day 27: maintenance without FBS
stages.base_medium: ScienCell Astrocyte Medium without FBS
stages.feeding: 2.5 mL per well on day 18, then half changes every 2-3 days from day 20 to day 27
actions: Full medium change on day 18
Half changes every 2-3 days thereafter

stages.name: Day 28: assay, or carry on to day 42 for more mature astrocytes
stages.base_medium: ScienCell Astrocyte Medium without FBS
stages.feeding: Continue half changes every 2-3 days; passage as on day 17 when cells approach confluence
actions: Score CD44, S100B, GFAP and ALDH1L1 at day 28
For higher GFAP and ALDH1L1, keep the culture to day 42 and hold it at higher confluency
The guide also gives qPCR primers for CD44, GFAP, S100B and ALDH1L1 normalised to PGK1, compared against human brain RNA
stages.checkpoint: CD44, S100B, GFAP and ALDH1L1-positive cells detectable at day 28; transcriptome correlation with primary astrocytes improves from day 14 to day 42

materials: Quick-Glia Astrocyte - SeV Kit (AS-SeV): QGA-SeV, Component N1, Component GA1, Component GA2
ScienCell Astrocyte Medium Kit (ScienCell 1801: basal medium, astrocyte growth supplement, FBS, penicillin-streptomycin)
Geltrex hESC-qualified reduced growth factor basement membrane matrix (Thermo A1569601)
StemFit Basic04 Complete Type (AMSBio SF041-001), StemFit AK02N or StemFlex (Thermo A3349401)
TrypLE Select Enzyme 1X (Thermo 12563011) and 0.02% EDTA in DPBS (Sigma E8008) for Solution D1
ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 (Selleckchem S1049) and DMSO (Sigma D2650)
Optional STEM-CELLBANKER (AMSBIO 11890) for cryopreserving at the day-3 passage
tips: Unlike the Quick-Neuron kits, this one has no puromycin selection step
Visible cell death the day after the 37 C shift is expected; the guide includes recovery images to compare against
Keeping the culture at higher confluency after day 28 raises GFAP expression
pitfalls: BSL-2 containment is required for the Sendai virus
A month of culture with a mid-run passage - contamination and feeding discipline matter more here than in the 7-10 day kits
The recommended replating density may not suit every hPSC line because growth rates differ
unverified: No purity percentage is published for this kit; evidence offered is marker detection, qPCR and transcriptome correlation rather than a positive-cell fraction
Post-thaw viability is quoted as approximately 80% for cells frozen at the day-17 passage, but no yield per starting well is given

kits.name: hPSC Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Kit (PSCCDK)
kits.principle: Three sequential serum-free differentiation media apply a growth-factor induction followed by temporal modulation of canonical Wnt signalling (on, then off) to a monolayer hPSC culture, then hand over to a cardiomyocyte growth medium; no embryoid body step is needed and contractions appear from day 7-10.
kits.product: Human Pluripotent Stem Cell Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Kit (PSCCDK)
kits.efficiency: Vendor claims high efficiency and a confluent sheet of cardiomyocytes from H9 cells; no percentage is stated
kits.start_requirements: Matrigel hESC-qualified matrix-coated plates (BD 354277), warmed to room temperature before use. hPSCs are maintained feeder-free, ideally in ScienCell STEMium medium (5801) though mTeSR1 or MEF conditioned medium are said to work equally well, and passaged at 80-90% confluency with StemDS dissociation solution (5803). For differentiation the cells are seeded onto Matrigel-coated 12-well plates in maintenance medium containing 5 uM Y-27632. The manual tells first-time users to titrate the seeding density across 0.05-1.5 x 10^6 cells per 12-well; for H9 in STEMium it recommends 0.8-1.0 x 10^5 cells per well in 2 mL (or 4 x 10^5 cells in 5 mL for a T-25). One kit covers two 12-well plates.

stages.name: Seeding the monolayer
stages.base_medium: hPSC maintenance medium (STEMium or equivalent) with 5 uM Y-27632

factors.name: Y-27632 (user-supplied)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor at 5 uM to aid attachment

stages.feeding: Single overnight culture; 2 mL per well of a 12-well plate
actions: Coat 12-well plates with Matrigel in advance and warm to room temperature
Lift 80-90% confluent hPSCs with StemDS (6-8 min at 37 C; colonies stay adherent) and dislodge in maintenance medium
Count and seed with 5 uM Y-27632, rocking the plate so the cells spread evenly
Culture overnight
stages.checkpoint: Even distribution across the well; the manual stresses that even seeding drives efficiency

stages.name: Day 0: Differentiation Medium A (24 h only)
stages.base_medium: Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Medium A (kit component 5901A)

factors.name: Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Medium A
factors.role: mesoderm induction with Wnt activation (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: 2 mL per well of a 12-well plate for exactly 24 h; record the time
actions: Thaw Medium A at room temperature and mix well
Replace the stem cell medium with 2 mL Medium A and note the exact time
Culture 24 h at 37 C
stages.checkpoint: Some cell death at 24 h is normal; losing more than 90% of the cells means the run will fail

stages.name: Day 1: Differentiation Medium B
stages.base_medium: Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Medium B (5901B)

factors.name: Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Medium B
factors.role: Wnt inhibition phase for cardiac mesoderm (composition proprietary)

kits.name: hPSC Neural Induction Medium (PSCNIM)
kits.principle: A serum-free induction medium based on dual SMAD inhibition and GSK3/TGF-beta blockade converts a sparsely seeded hPSC monolayer into a dense, homogeneous neuroepithelium in seven days, giving nestin/SOX2-positive neural stem cells that can be expanded or patterned further.
kits.efficiency: Vendor states more than 90% of cells express the neural stem cell markers nestin and SOX2 after 7-10 days, with loss of NANOG
kits.start_requirements: Matrigel hESC-qualified matrix-coated 12-well plates (BD 354277). hPSCs are kept feeder-free (ScienCell STEMium 5801 routinely, passaged every 3-5 days) and lifted at 70-80% confluency with StemDS (5803, 8-10 min at 37 C until the cells round up but stay adherent). Seed at 2.5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 in maintenance medium with 5 uM Y-27632; for STEMium-grown cells the manual recommends 0.1 x 10^6 cells per well of a 12-well plate in 2 mL. The culture should be only about 20% confluent on the day induction starts.

stages.name: Seeding sparsely
stages.base_medium: hPSC maintenance medium (STEMium or equivalent) with 5 uM Y-27632

factors.name: Y-27632 (user-supplied)
factors.role: ROCK inhibitor at 5 uM for attachment

stages.feeding: Single overnight culture; 2 mL per well of a 12-well plate
actions: Coat 12-well plates with Matrigel ahead of time
Lift 70-80% confluent hPSCs with StemDS and dislodge in maintenance medium
Count and seed at 2.5 x 10^4 cells/cm2 with 5 uM Y-27632, rocking to spread the cells evenly
Culture overnight
stages.checkpoint: About 20% confluency on the morning induction starts; even distribution matters for efficiency

stages.name: Days 1-3: neural induction begins
stages.base_medium: Complete neural induction medium (basal medium 5931-b with 50x supplement 5982)

factors.name: Neural induction medium supplement (50x, 5982)
factors.role: dual SMAD plus GSK3/TGF-beta inhibition cocktail (composition proprietary)

stages.feeding: 2 mL per well, changed daily
actions: Thaw the 50x supplement, add it to the basal medium and mix
Replace the stem cell medium with induction medium on day 1
Change the medium daily on days 2 and 3
stages.checkpoint: Cells usually reach 90-100% confluency by day 3

stages.name: Days 4-7: rising medium volumes as the sheet thickens
stages.base_medium: Complete neural induction medium
stages.feeding: Daily changes with increasing volume: 3 mL per well on days 4-5, 4 mL on days 6-7
actions: Change the medium daily, stepping the volume up as the culture thickens
If the dense culture starts to lift, split once with StemDS and replate at high density
Neural patterning cues such as retinoic acid, SHH or FGF8 can be introduced from day 5 if a specific regional identity is wanted
stages.checkpoint: A dense multilayer neuroepithelium by day 7

stages.name: Day 8: harvest the neural stem cells
stages.base_medium: Complete neural induction medium until harvest, then Neural Expansion Medium (ScienCell 5941)

factors.name: Neural Expansion Medium (ScienCell 5941, sold separately)
factors.role: expansion medium for the derived NSCs

stages.feeding: Harvest on day 8; expanded NSCs are replated at high density (split 1:6 to 1:10) with ROCK inhibitor
actions: On day 8 confirm that more than 90% of cells are nestin-positive
Dissociate with CellEase (ScienCell 5813) for maintenance passaging, adding ROCK inhibitor to the plating medium
Expand in Neural Expansion Medium for at least 5 passages, or differentiate onward
Before passaging, manually remove non-neural colonies interspersed in the neuroepithelium
stages.checkpoint: More than 90% nestin-positive and SOX2-positive, with NANOG lost

materials: hPSC Neural Induction Medium (ScienCell 5931: neural induction basal medium 5931-b plus 50x supplement 5982)
StemDS cell dissociation solution (ScienCell 5803), CellEase (5813) and DPBS without calcium and magnesium (0303)
STEMium hPSC growth medium (ScienCell 5801) or another feeder-free maintenance medium
Neural Expansion Medium (ScienCell 5941) for NSC expansion
tips: The starting culture is deliberately sparse - about 20% confluent - because the sheet thickens enormously over the week
Step the medium volume up through the week as the manual specifies; under-feeding a multilayer culture causes it to lift
Regional patterning factors can go in as early as day 5 if neurons of a particular identity are the goal
pitfalls: Non-neural colonies among the neuroepithelium must be scraped or aspirated off before passaging or they take over
If the dense sheet detaches late in the week, split once with StemDS and replate densely rather than letting it lift
Line-specific adjustment, such as longer induction or different first-passage timing, is expected
